So far, I haven't encountered a dish I didn't thoroughly enjoy (Disclaimer: I've only had the omakase options and haven't ventured too deep into their menu), and I make sure to stop by whenever there's an update to the menu or something new is added. Apart from food, ambiance is good and, depending on when you arrive, you may to wait a bit, but it's never been too long for me. There's also a waiting area upstairs apart from the one downstairs, so you're good to wait there if weather isn't good. You can also find a spot at the bar and drink/eat there, which I've also done and had a pretty good time.
Best of the best.  Really just wonderful all around from service to food. Everyone should experience Sugar Fish

Enjoyed our dining experience here.The fish was super fresh.   Although we had to wait a bit (it was Saturday night after all), we loved both the omakase & the vibe.  Service (& the other patrons) was also super friendly.  We will likely return soon.

This place is the best! The manager remembers my name each time I return - which is very frequently. The food is fresh and delicious. I have had sushi far more expensive that is not nearly as good. The rice is delicious and the staff - warm, inviting and knowledgeable. It's too bad there is no tipping accepted as they deserve it!

My fiancé and I are sushi enthusiasts and having been to all the top places in NYC we thought we'd give Sugarfish a try since it was nearby some errands.  Stopped in for lunch on a Saturday and wow.  Simply put, Sugarfish went to the top of the list basically tied with Sushi Nakazawa but about 50% less expensive.  Absolutely amazingly fresh sushi and delicious omakase.  Will definitely return in the near future.

Been here multiple times and would gladly return for another trip. I usually order the trust me, the nozawa or the don't think just eat. The standout are the toro, seabass, seabream and the albacore sushi. The other items, I would consider them okay for a casual sushi eater. I know where Sugarfish fits into my sushi range of establishment. It's amazing for its price and what they offer.

Dining with sister, we ordered "The Nozawa Trust Me" course, all the items are sooo fresh and it literally melt in my mouth. I don't need chew long. The sushi rice was still warm and it's just right to eat it right away. The toro hand roll was highly recommended to eat it right away while the seaweed are still crispy. The waitress was attentive and the atmosphere is nice to chat, not too noisy.

Always exceptional. I've loved every experience here. I look forward to my days in SoHo because of Sugarfish- well, and SoHo. I typically order the "trust me" which leaves me full and happy. No need for any additions or modifications - each dish is perfect.
Best sushi I've had in nyc. The albacore belly and unagi sushi were amazing. Great service and ambience.

Loved, loved, loved the food and service here! Everything was so good, I didn't think to take pictures, I  just wanted to dig in.

Heads up, this place is super popular, so you have to get there before they open if you want to be seated early. 

Definitely a  go to spot anytime me and my crew are craving sushi.

Bottomline: Recommend!
One of my fav sushi places. get the trust me. get there as soon as they open to try to get a table.

TLDR:  It's a scam. Don't waste your money here. I have never, ever, in my entire life feeling bored, or sick of eating sashimi. This is the first time I've ever experienced that feeling, here at Sugarfish.
I've heard a lot about Sugarfish. Seeing how people compliment the place and the dishes, I was really excited to try out this restaurant. Got here on a Thursday night and the restaurant was really crowded, but was seated  right away since I came alone to eat lol. With the intention to enjoy all the good food by myself, I was really disappointed with my experience dining at Sugarfish. I order "The Nozawa: Trust Me" but I guess that I should not do so, I shouldn't trust it. The nicest thing I can say is that the food was far off from the positive reviews.
Before headed to Sugarfish, I was craving for some sashimi and was also also bored, so I decided to document my trip to Sugarfish on snapchat so my friends can go on a food tour with me. Every single picture below demonstrates how I felt about the food at Sugarfish.
This place never disappoints. New menu teaser "Don't Think, Just Eat" is a keeper. Have dined with family, friends, and out of town guests here and they always say it's worth the wait.

Great food but terrible management. Brainless hostesses told us it would be a 30 minute wait (which we were willing to do for great food) but after an hour we checked in and suddenly it was a 2 hour wait. Thanks for wasting our time
A simple takeout order - 2 Trust Me's - took 43 minutes!  Very slow service!!!! The restaurant has not worked out its service problems.

This is literally one of my favorite restaurants in NYC. This is my go-to when I want to treat myself on a date. Regardless what Pete Wells has to say, I enjoy the  fresh fish and the way they make their rice. It's such a nostalgic feeling everytime i come here. I come in the off hours so I never have a hard time getting a spot at the sushi bar. Being from LA I've been to the other location but since I live here I find this location to be top notch! You can tell it's managed very well both back of house and front of house. Staff super friendly. This is a must for sushi goers in NYC. You totally get your monies worth!

The sushi itself was delicious and well prepared however the service  was incredibly rushed with the server bringing the first three courses of our Trust Me tasting menu within less than one minute of eachother. We had three plates each piling up in front of us before we even got through half of our first course edamame.  I'd return for the fish but pass on the service unless for some reason I wanted to be pressured to finish my dinner before 10 minutes time.

Food was incredible as always.. We had a really crappy rude server named crystall. She basically threw a plate of sushi at me and was talking into space while telling me about it. The staff is usually so amazing, def disappointed with this experience. It was my friends first time. She was in total shock.

HORRiBLE‼‼SO SO OVER RATED and a SCAMM! 
Waaay OVER PRiCED ,..biggest RiP  OFF ever!!!
I know  sishi,.. NOT authentic at all! Don't even go there  with someond unless you plan to spend a
Minimum of $100.00+ ,and you'll STiLL be hungry! 
Cannot believe that they actually get away with all this BS there !

Sugarfish is very hyped but don't let that fool you. The food is good- but the experience, presentation, ambiance and service are all far from memorable, and in some respects, pretty poor. I don't mind waiting for tables in New York, it's something you expect, but get this: i was called back via text to the restaurant to get my table. Upon arrival, the host informed me it would still be a couple minutes. I told him I was going to the restroom upstairs with my friend, and he said fine just don't go far (huh?!). WHILE I was on the toilet (note: there are only two and I had to wait in a line for one) I hear someone screaming my name saying my table was ready. Obviously I can't pee any faster. Thank god my friend caught the host, so they didn't end up giving our table away. Keep in mind, we waited two hours for this table. Lol. 

Again; the food is good. But for such a shit experience I say you're better off going to their fast food sister restaurant, KazuNori, which tastes just as yummy and doesn't masquerade as a dining experience. Pretty shameful.

I have heard about Sugarfish for so long, and I am glad that I was able to check it out one weekday afternoon for lunch. I had just finished an interview and was looking for a spot to have a solo lunch. I figured I could sit at the bar for a nice experience. I got there about 1:30pm on a Friday, and I was 13th in line for a party of one at the bar. It was definitely packed in there! I put my name down with the hostess, and walked around while I waited for a text message to tell me that I was near the top of the list. Once my seat was ready, I was taken to the back and seated at the bar area. The restaurant is pretty big, and like the atmosphere with the minimalistic wooden touches. 

Sugarfish is known for their premium sushi, and they have three main "prefixe" options: Trust Me, Trust Me Lite, and Nowaza Trust Me. Each one has a signature selection of sushi, but you can also order al a carte and from their specials menu. I decided to go with the Trust Me and added an Anago sushi (because I can't go to sushi without having eel!). 

I must say that Sugarfish is definitely worth the hype. The price might seem high, but I have never had better quality sushi in my life. The fish literally melted in my mouth and was so flavorful on its own. They recommend not using any additional soy sauce and eating right away, and I followed their instructions to the T without regrets.  

The staff was super friendly and efficient with bringing my dishes and clearing my plates. They explained everything to me since it  was my first time, and they were also very personable with all of the guests from first timers to the regulars. 

I will definitely be back at Sugarfish at some point. Sushi is my favorite cuisine and Sugarfish just does it right!

Ugh. Not worth the hype. We tried the Nozawa pre set menu for $52 and it was like ordering  Aji Sushi on seamless but you pay twice as much and wait twice as long. Some lowlights: cold edamame, poorly salted ; handrolls with warm rice, cold fish and rice falling out on both ends once you take your first bite; waiters bringing out one plate of food for our party of 2, and returning 3 min later with the other plate- for handrolls to be eaten immediately that just means off sync food...

The one positive? Price includes tax and tip. Yay?

I know it says three dollar signs but it feels more like $$. The amount of food you get for $30+ is better then anywhere else and they do a great job of keeping quality high even as they push sushi out quickly. The wait can be a bit annoying and anywhere up to 3 hours. If you plan to go here, throw your name on the list and then head to any one of the cool bars in the area. Just don't show up hungry or you may be disappointed with the wait. 

They don't have hot sake, which is fine. Just a heads up if that's what your are particular to.

I've heard all the hype about this prized restaurant, admired by common people and celebrities alike! It wasn't until I actually ate here this Wednesday that I was exceeded of my expectations.

I'd arrived at 6:20pm and was seated by 7:45pm. The meals are omakase style with limited a la carte. Individually we ordered the "Trust Me" for $40 a person. Multiple options of nigiri from salmon and tuna, crab hand rolls, etc rolled out throughout the night. We were able to finish each dish within 1 minute of it being set on the table. While it may be just salmon and rice, the rice was warmed perfectly sticky and soft covered in some light sauce. There was just something special about each dish that came out. I will definitely recommend this restaurant (if you can handle the wait) and I can't wait for my next time here!

We recently went back to sugarfish but this time to the south village location. We ordered the nozawa trust me menu and loved it! However it is a lot of food and we both agreed we would probably stick with the trust me menu next time unless we were really hungry. My favorite pieces are still the sea bass and salmon! I also love the crab hand roll.

I don't get it.  I really don't.  The sushi was good, yes, but I've had plenty of good sushi in my life that I didn't have to wait 2 hours  for.  Yes, I know the wait is part of their "thing" and it's nice that they are willing to text you, but if you're waiting that long, if the demand is that high, I  expect to have my socks knocked off.  Not the case.
We put our names in and go on our way.  We receive our text and head back over.  We are offered a spot at the bar, but it's not a bar.  It's a counter with the coolers for the beer behind it and the bus tubs and garbage cans for all of the uneaten food.  Not a bar, not a sushi bar.  There are six open seats at the "bar" aka slop sink, and we are seated in the two seats closest to the kitchen door so that within the first 30 seconds I am bumped in to twice.  We ask to move to two of the four empty seats that remain, and we are initially told  no, but then the hostess came back and moved us.  
The server goes over the menu, explaining how it works.  Despite the fact that we are sitting  basically in the garbage area, looking at  full bus tubs, we decide to give it a go and order "Don't think just eat" the omakase special.  Well, now the server decides to tell us that they don't have that.  Why she went over the  menu but neglected to tell us what they were  out of is beyond me.  At that point we considered leaving, but we were starving.  We shared the "Trust Me" and a few other pieces.  It was good.  Was my mind blown?  No.  Was the price  reasonable? Yes.  Was I eating looking at garbage cans?  Yes.
Here's the kicker: I went upstairs to use the ladies' room.  There is a TON of space upstairs,  like enough room  for a whole other restaurant.  So I ate in basically a work station, after waiting two hours, when there's enough room for at least 40 more covers upstairs.  
I will never go back, and they obviously don't care.  Skip it.  There's plenty of sushi in NYC.

Sushi is yummy but  Our order took forever to come, she gave us 2 orders of salmon sashimi when we actually 4 ordered salmon negiri and yellow tail negiri and cut rolls. She then took those away and gave it to the table right next to us. Saying"these were made by mistake would you like to try these they are complementary?" And the table said of course. After wards our real order came out( half of it) and it was dropped to that same table next to us. The table next to us said I think we have your food...it was so embarrassing. Obviously that table got a nice free portion of sushi while we are still waiting. The waitress then said sorry for the confusion I just called for your order. Then only 1 order of negri can out after waiting so long. We were still waiting for the rest of our order and all the waitress could say is the chefs bring them out when they are ready it's all coursed out. When we finally got the rest of our food the check was dropped and the waitress said no signage required, no apology no comps,nothing. We go there so often and now we feel bad about this place. Hopefully the management makes good on this.

I'm quite baffled why Sugarfish received such great reviews. Perhaps their review from the NY Times helped propel them over other sushi establishments but the concept of fish being wrapped over warm rice as their selling point did not do the trick for me. Instead, it left me feeling unsatisfied and confused.

I came here for lunch on a Monday and made sure to arrive 5 min before 11am (opening time) as I read a crowd will form very quickly, which it did. Once inside, the staff greeted us and seated everyone and I have to say, the restaurant filled up fast.

I sat at the "sushi bar" area, which is not exactly a sushi bar area. Instead it's an area where the staff prep their side dishes and prepare teas and tap water for their guests. Once seated I was presented with the menu and was immediately told which one was their best seller. I went with their "Trust Me" pre-set menu and immediately their sushi started coming out fast.

Their organic edamame was cold. Not room temperature but cold as in their soy bean has been sitting in the fridge for quite sometime. It was also cooked in salt water so while eating it, all I tasted was salt water combined with cold beans (not good). When I was done, they started serving the nigiri I ordered. I could feel the waitress watching me and eat so she can bring out the next one right after. The nigiri was okay. I didn't like how warm and sour the rice was. It over powered the light natural flavor of the fish and the fish was not buttery. Instead it tasted more mushy and lacked texture and body.

As for my hand rolls, I found it interesting how my waitress told me to not wait and it should be eaten immediately. At first, I didn't know why but once I took a bite, I knew it's because the warm rice would just ruin the whole experience should it sit any longer as the seaweed will get rubbery and the seafood inside will start cooking.

Overall, I can't see myself coming back. I didn't get to see any of the sushi chef prepare my sushi. Instead peeking through the kitchen window, all I saw was a sushi factory like kitchen of people prepping food in the back. 

Lastly, I dislike that teas are not complimentary and I dislike that I was rushed and I disliked that their rice is over powered by the vinegar. For those who still want to go, I say more power to them but for me, I would say skip this place and go somewhere else.

This is the best sashimi you'll find. It's not cheap so be prepared to pay $50-$100 per person. 

The sashimi melts in your mouth. The sauce is very light, and not overly salty. Even the soy sauce they provide tastes a little different than the typical. 

Would highly recommend the tuna and salmon sashimi

The salmon nigiri is amazing as well. 
If you like yellow tail, they have one of the best yellow tails

The waitress gave us the Toro nigiri, which is a cut of Bluefin tuna, on the house (worth $8x4)

The albacore tuna was good, but not my favorite. It felt a little tougher to eat. 

Sea bass - also a very expensive cut of sushi. It's definitely a tougher cut than the others types of sushi, but definitely worth a try!

Sea bream - a snapper fish. Not sure why it isn't called snapper...there's a whole article on this. Not my favorite but you decide. 

I had a crab hand roll, which came with real crab meat and was actually my favorite hand roll.

I was very skeptical to try this place !!! Okay! All who know me know that I'm a huge lover of sushi , but specifically fish ! Whenever I go to my neighborhood sushi spot , I never order sashimi because I'm afraid the smell will turn me off from eating my entire meal !! My client (who doesn't not have social media , for once )! Took me to this amazing authentic Japanese sushi restaurant in flatiron and all I have to say is " wow   wow  wow  ... 
not only is everything beyond fresh and imported daily from California (Pacific Ocean) , it literally melts in your mouth ! Even the rice ! Everything is above and beyond yummy  I ordered 1 of each item on the menu just to try ... they are so authentic, they don't even make or carry siracha , or spicy mayo  I was surprised about that part but the homemade wasabi made up for it . I ate it all !!!! Nose on fire  and all ! Haha . The most interesting part of this restaurant is that they have a no tipping policy , apparently in Japan  it is a traditional and cultural thing not to tip . It's not even included in the bill. If you offer them a top they will refuse it  I give this place a   7 star rating ... 1-5 ? nope , 7 !!!

Have heard so many amazing things about SUGARFISH so finally gave it a try. Only thing I regret is that I didn't try it sooner!! The fish was so fresh and the service was great! You can either order a prefix or do a la carte. We ordered different things of the menu and there was nothing that was a disappointment. My favorite was the albacore belly and yellowtail - literally melts in your mouth! The split rolls (crab, lobster, yellowtail) were great as well! Definitely a must try, but keep in mind the wait does get long so it's a good idea to put your name down and get a drink somewhere near by.

I LOVE Sugarfish. I think the quality is up there with Nobu with a much more reasonable price tag. I usually get the middle sized tasting menu and leave really full and satisfied. My boyfriend gets the higher one and it isn't much more food, but isn't much more money either.

As everyone said, you really never know how long you'll have to wait so I'd advise going at "off" times and don't go starving as you may need to wait. But it is so so so worth it!

Not going to lie about my experience with this place. Me and my group of friends of COLOR came in and they skipped us on the wait list about 3 times. Spoke to manager Linna and she was so unpleasant. Very suspicious that they were skipping us, we felt neglected. Would never come back here and I also didn't see not ONE colored person here, interesting!

Came during the corona madness and they were taking such massive steps to make sure everyone in the restaurant felt safe and clean. They had open tables between each full party to enforce social distancing. Also, they were cloroxing and sanitizing  every table between each party. As a customer, this made me feel sad eating here. 100% recommend coming during this time period (and always)

A favorite the sushi is incredibly melt in your mouth fresh! I have taken most of my friends who have come to visit here, the only negative is it raises the bar so high most other sushi spots can't compete. Never a chewy bite! Atmosphere is dark and intimate- great for lunch or dinner.

Went there when visited NYC - simply amazing! We got the Nozawa Trust Me and couple more choices from ala carte and it was just enough to be full but not stuffed. 
I loved that tipping was included in the total price and that didn't impact the service we received.

COVID delivery diary.... 

Ordered sugarfish on Postmates for Monday dinner. Food came 20 minutes after I ordered. I am impressed by how fresh the fish is and how delicate the packaging is. Zero fishiness, perfectly cooked rice and 3 types of seasonings. I got the trust me lite, which is definitely enough food for me.

Thank the heavens that SUGARFISH opened in NYC because I was not about to waste more airline points flying back to Cali to get my fill! It's always packed, but you can actually order the takeout boxes to go and sit and eat in Mad Square Park-- PRO TIP!!

Wait is extremely long, but definitely have to come try it for yourself! The sushi is SUPER FRESH!!! Everything was very delicious! 

I would say it's worth the wait once in awhile and a great treat yourself meal! 

We did the Trust Me combinations and it was the best!! It made me try things I normally wouldn't order and it turned out to be very tasty!! 

The service was great!! They were super busy, yet very patient and attentive to all the tables!

Ordered to go nozawa, and added a side orders of scallop sushi, nozawa style shrimp sushi, pink lobster, sweet shrimp sushi, and split cut roll with lobster. I love the presentation, how everything is in the box, you won't go looking for sides or sauces. It even has a cute little golden sauce dish. As to the food itself, I love how it's so fresh, and simple, it's how you're supposed to eat sushi!

There are no words to describe how much I love this place. Every friend that comes into town bring them here for the omakasi. The price is definitely good for the quality and service. Only downside is they don't take reservations first come first serve. There are plenty of bars in the area where you can kill time. The first time we came we waited almost 2 hours (still new) but it seems to have gotten better 45min wait but it's worth it!
Really fresh fish and kind service. The only place I will go for sushi during quarantine times. Go support them! You won't regret it. Packaging was lovely as well.

The short: super impressed by how quickly, safely, deliciously and effectively SUGARFISH pulled off its to-go operations.

The longer: I ordered by telephone for pickup during the coronavirus pandemic. I called on the earlier side (5pm) but had no problem getting through. Pickup was perfectly on time and organized. There's tape on the ground and tables for contactless pickup. Whole pickup experience took five minutes. 

The FOOD. Omg. The sushi was on-point. We had a trust me nozawa box and added the lobster hand cut and toro hand cut, plus large scallop and salmon sushi. Everything was so fresh, and the rice is so much softer than sushi you'd normally get to go. 

The winners: lobster roll, salmon, large scallop and sea bream. Loved the whole experience! Highly recommend.

A+++++++
Albacore!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!!! 
Salmon is really great here. 
Our favorite is the albacore belly and tuna sashimi!!

Restaurant is closed but pick up is available... all was packaged very neatly and fish was very fresh (as always). Definitely recommending to all sushi lovers : ) 

One of the best places in NYC!

The sushi is amazing and so fresh. I love eating here and have been doing takeout since covid isolation... just as fresh and amazing! The only downside is they don't take reservations, but it is worth the wait!
Got lunch takeout from here today. Sushi was fresh and delicious. Extra points for the lovely way it was packaged. Will definitely order from here again!

SUGARFISH occupies the important niche of being better than delivering quality sushi but not quite omakase level prices. I've been here 3-4 times and have found that Nozawa Trust-Me to be the best price per value ratio.

When dining in, there is usually a long wait but during COVID times. During COVID times, the food is ready pretty instantaneously. I have never felt more safe getting takeout at another restaurant. They have a meticulous system in which you're able to pickup the food without contact.

The food is packaged in a premium to-go box with various dipping sauces and methods of eating. There is zero fishiness, so you know the food is fresh. Each sushi has a recommended way to dress it up. I want to save the surprise of the sushi itself for when you open the box - it's like a birthday gift!

I ordered take out from here tonight and it was amazing! I had the Trust Me combo and it was a great price for the amount of food and the quality. There were 16 pieces of sushi, a few slices of sashimi, and edamame for $40. The fish was great quality - it all tasted delicious and fresh. The box came packaged with sauces and toppings (e.g., scallions) on the side. They had a really cute box for take out that detailed how to prepare each piece of sushi with all of the toppings. I really liked each and every piece of food that came with this combo. They were also nice about accommodating a kosher diet, and let me make substitutions to the combo based on my diet. The food was also ready really quickly (probably about 20-25 mins after I ordered). I am so happy with this experience and would do this again.

I have dined in at Sugarfish pre-COVID and while I really liked the food then, the entire meal felt like I was being rushed through. They would bring the next course before we were done with the current course, and they would try to take dishes away while we were still working on them. All in all, I had a much more enjoyable experience doing take out as opposed to dining in - so take advantage of this now!

This restaurant was absolutely amazing. I went to get takeout from here for dinner with my mom and it exceeded my expectations. I got the to go trust me lite and an order of unagi nigiri and my mom got the to go trust me. The texture of every piece of fish was perfect and the sauces recommended for certain pieces of sushi paired perfectly with the flavors of the fish. Pickup was also very convenient and straightforward. Overall a great experience and I can't wait to go back once it opens up for indoor dining.

One of our go-to sushi places in the gramercy area. Was very happy to hear that they were open for takeout and delivery. 

We ordered the "To go trust me" and the "To go Nozawa trust me". We were surprised at how quickly they were able to delivery. The quality of the fish was excellent and as fresh as we remembered when we dined in. The rice was seasoned to perfection as usual with just the right amount of vinegar. 

We thoroughly enjoyed our Sugarfish delivery experience!

We ordered for pickup during covid and got the "To Go Trust Me" box. We love sushi and have tried many places. We couldn't resist the hype and sadly, we weren't amazed. Some of the fish didn't taste fresh. Maybe we'll give it another chance and update this review.

Sushi was good! I read reviews about the rice and I think I had the same experience. The rice is too vinegary and falls apart way too easily. If those two things were fixed it'd be 5 stars. They do takeout sushi better than anyone else.

I must have been here at-least, minimum, 250 times in the last 4 years. This is our teams go-to weekly lunch spot and probably the only few things in life that make me truly happy.

Good luck finding the quality and variety of fish anywhere else in NY - it truly does not come close. You'll never eat regular sushi ever again after eating here. This is the holy grail of sushi spots. I could go on but you get the point.

Favorite Sushi of all time .. I could eat it everyday if I could ! I get the trust me (Always Amazing) Also The yellowtail roll is one of my favs , Sweet shrimp, & that salmon sushi is to die for honestly Everything is so fresh and truly melts in your mouth . It's heaven in your mouth.  5/5 for me

One of my go to sushi spots. I ordered takeout a few times during the pandemic and the quality of the sushi was still so high. I recently went to experience outdoor dining that is now available and it was one of the best meals I've had in a long time. If you know Sugarfish then you know the warm rice and fresh seaweed on the hand rolls make the dining experience worth while. I got there around 4:30pm on a Saturday and I had to wait about 30 minutes on a waitlist but I easily walked around and had a drink at a nearby spot until my table was ready.

sugarfish is my go to place when I want sushi for a good price. it's not the BEST sushi in the world, but in my opinion, it's the best sushi you can get in the usa at its $30-60 price point. the fish is always fresh and consistently delicious. their rice truly enhances the sushi or nigiri, and their sauce pairings are divine. i got the "Don't think just eat" and split it with a friend. we weren't hungry or full at the end, which was just perfect because we had dessert and boba to go with our meal. I'd highly recommend if you're a first-timer to get any of the "Trust Me"s. the variety and fish quality alone will turn you in a sugarfish lover! 

I'm always craving this place, can't wait for the next time I can go back!
Fresh fish. Nice presentation. I enjoyed it the second time more than the first. Highly recommended.

We waited around 3 hours for a table, so by the time I was seated, I kind of expected this place to be a little overrated, especially since it's one of those places you always see on Instagram. It seemed like it couldn't live up to the hype. 

But honestly, Sugarfish did live up to the hype. I got one of the trust me meals and shared the unfiltered sake and everything was really, really good. My meal worked out to about 89$ which is more expensive than I would usually spend, but I think in this case was a fair price. 

I can't really give specific details about each course, since I don't remember which sushi was which. But all of it was good. The fish was buttery, fresh-tasting, and the ones that came with sauce were perfectly complemented. 

The service was also top notch. Our waitress was so nice and accommodating--I made a point to remember her name to give her due credit, but now I can't remember it! Oops. 

Anyway, the wait is crazy but bearable because you can put your name in online. And in my opinion, the sushi is worth the hassle.
Sushi is fresh and service is amazing! Definitely recommend putting your name on the waitlist via their site; made the whole experience super efficient. Expect to wait 30-40 minutes at least

I've been coming to Sugarfish since they opened their first location in Flatiron. I love that they take the guess work out of ordering with their menu design. They have great customer service and attention to detail. All the fish taste fresh and their to-go boxes give suggestions on which condiment goes on which fish to really bring out the flavor.

Ordered delivery from here and got the Trust Me Combo and it was delicious! There was just enough food where you feel full and satisfied but not stuffed. Everything was fresh and the packaging was adorable - the box had instructions on how to prepare and eat each piece of sushi with all of the toppings. It's also very easy to make substitutions while ordering if you don't eat a particular fish. The delivery arrived quickly and the price is fair considering the quality of the food!

My friends recommend this place and I wanted to come here for long time, I finally made it. 

I tried Trust Me, everything is incredibly delicious. Love all hand rolls and tuna sashimi. My friends got Dont Think, Just Eat. which is also excellent, I will get it next time.  

Outside seating is not bad, food here make you forget everything. Service is everything, fast and very attentive. 

Will definitely come back!
Love their delivery take out boxes and service is always great. Their sushi / sashimi is fresh.

My second time picking up my food here. Very confusing with this DTJE, we didnt know what we were eating as there was no way to tell. Even the website menu doest tell us what 's in the box! Then we find FISH SCALE!! Good thing i didnt swallow that!  Not again!!

Soooo delicious.  Came here pre-COVID to celebrate my cousin's birthday.  The fish is so fresh and while it doesn't seem like a lot of food I was filled after eating "trust me" (and I can eat a lot of sushi).  It was the perfect amount and well worth the price for the quality you get.  The fish melts in your mouth.  We went right when it opened for lunch on a random Thursday so there was no line.  I hope this place stays open through the pandemic because it's a must try.  Maybe a little steep for an everyday staple but really nice for a once in a while special treat.

It's amazingly fresh sushi- packaged perfectly for takeout/delivery. My order was delivered looking exactly like the picture online!! The price is a little higher than the average sushi place but still reasonable considering how fresh and the quality of the fish.
The idea of the box with descriptions of how to eat is very neat- I think it's a bit pricy but sushi was fresh and good

Read the reviews and was skeptical at first, until I craved sushi during months long deprived of good quality sushi and found Sugarfish to satisfy my palette.  The reason why I chose this restaurant is because they took social distancing seriously more than some other sushi venues, where not only the staff wears masks, but they wipe down the tables and distance the tables apart with plexiglass separating tables adequately.  They made sure others on wait list does not crowd themselves over the table seating area.
Their tipping hospitality fee is waived, despite impeccable service with smile and unending meticulous service, including hot green tea served piping hot and will fill more hot water if requested, due to colder weather.  We ordered Trust Me & Trust Me Lite, which was divine and served warm to be consumed immediately.  If it wasn't a cold rainy day, we'd have even ordered more from their special of the day.  Do wear layers during colder months, as outdoor seating is mandated currently in NYC. Only regret is they only serve cold sake, but perhaps the chef believes the pairing is better with cold sake.  I gave this place a 5 star due to exceptional quality of sushi and service, and at this moment well practiced safety measurements.  Tells me their attention to detail that was very important.

Ordered the To-Go Nozawa Trust Me from Postmates and was very pleased. I'm still in the process of understanding how great sushi is different from good sushi, but I could tell this was definitely more than good sushi. When I first got the delivery, the sushi slid to one side so I had to shift the pieces around. I really like the instructions on how to enjoy each type of fish. I also like how they have nigiri style because it feels like you get more of the taste of the pure fish. I rate 4 out of 5 stars just because it is kinda pricey ($46) for the amount of sushi. I also was not able to confirm what the daily special I got in my box was (could be sea bass could be idkkk).

A+++ for the outdoor set up here, and an equal A+++ for the sushi itself.

The outdoor tables are separated by plexiglass, covered, and they have the absolute best heaters I've ever seen at any restaurant during outdoor dining. They're basically face level when you sit down and they work so well the only thing that might stay cold is your feet. Incredible.

The service is wonderful, attentive (they brought us more hot water for our teas without us even asking), and the waiters wear gloves and masks.

But the food.... wow. Quite possibly the best sushi I've had, so fresh and such great quality. We both got the Trust Me, a kind of omakase style in the sense that what they bring out is determined by them and it has a number of courses (around 8). Some of my favorites of the night were the tuna sashimi, the salmon sushi and the toro hand roll. They explain on their menu which dishes should be eaten with soy sauce or not, and as someone who is a fan of soy sauce I really only ate maybe one of the dishes with it because the rice and the fish were so well done anyway.

I've always liked hand rolls but these are served so quickly that the rice was still warm and the seaweed still crispy, the ideal hand roll.

Also, the green tea was so good. A great addition to a cold night. Order some sake, too, and you won't even realize you're eating outside.

I'll definitely be back. Highly recommend.

3 stars, review of the trust me omakase

For me, the most memorable items of this set are the toro hand roll and crab hand roll. I think everything else tasted better than average but not particularly memorable, and that's why I give it 3 stars.

I did add an order of uni (which comes in 2pcs) on top of the omakase and I would add 1/2 a star to my review just for this one item. It was absolutely bursting to the brim with uni and tasted so gooood. 

Alas, the yummy uni is not enough for me to come back again.
The food is great but the staff is rude. One star goes to the unfriendly hostess in the front.

Ordered the to-go Trust Me... I was shocked at how fresh the sushi was. I had heard AMAZING things about this place but I didn't realize it would ruin all other sushi for me. Nothing compares! I told my boyfriend so he had to try it (he doesn't really care for sushi or any seafood for that matter) so I gave him a salmon sushi. He said "wow! This IS really good"
Love the sushi here! I wish the rice remained together a little more but certainly no reason for a rating reduction! Always fresh fish and excellent service!
Officially just became  a mediocre sushi place in my book. It's just blah comparing to what it use to be like. The fish is not as seasoned as it use to be. The rice is not on point.. not as hot

Okay FYI sign up on the waitlist before you get there. We arrived to Sugar fish and scanned the QR code on the door (they have a sign on the door about this but it could be missed). 18 people were in front of us and an employee said we could wait up to an hour but we only waited for about 30mins. We legit had ...workout clothes on so yes we were way dressed down but it is what it is during covid lol.
Raquel was our waitress and let me say the staff seems so nice. There was one lady at the front door that was rubbing a few customers the wrong way but the male hostess was calming her "abrasiveness" down. The staff though is INSANE. Their knowledge on the menu is extensive, they even pair certain sakes for you. (I honestly felt bad that the tip was included in the price because our waitress was dealing with a very nasty customer and was keeping her cool.) 
Let me say I had Sugar fish in LA and was not a HUGE fan because I felt like they used a lot of mayo but I must say now here in NYC I have been to this location twice and it's amazing. In the past we ordered 2 trust me boxes and 2 orders of edamame ...which isn't near enough for us lol. This time we got Dont Think Just Eat and the Pink Lobster Special. The tuna sashimi that came with the DTJE was NEXT LEVEL. Whatever sauce they put on it, something with scallions, WOW. We also had hot green tea, but the sake was tempting. 
The hand rolls of course are amazing especially because they are warm. You do need to be in house to get the hand rolls (I actually appreciate this.) 
I didn't write a review before when we did take out because during covid you have to give restaurants a fair chance. The outdoor seating is a little janky since the door dash and grub hub delivery people also have to wait where the seating is. So it is VERY crowded, we opted to sit inside but again I feel like the places are doing as much as they can given the circumstances.
Overall 4/5 because Kazu Nori is also INSANE with their hand roll game. I'm giving 5/5 because the waitress Raquel was amazing!

This sushi lives up to the hype. If you're a picky eater, or only like sushi rolls, I wouldn't recommend it, but if you are a real sushi lover this place is for you. All of the fish is obviously super fresh, but the way it is prepared is just so good. I would recommend not doing takeout from here though, everything was still really good but it gets all messed up in the box. Not the same experience but I will be back here in person after the pandemic!

Will preface this by saying I don't have very refined taste buds for sushi BUT especially at this price point, Sugarfish has become my go-to when I'm feeling good quality sushi. There are a number of restaurants in NYC that do omakase at a similar price range (~$50 per person) and I'd say Sugarfish is one of the better experiences AND is on the more affordable end too. The Trust Me is a great option both in terms of the quality and quantity of food. If you want to add on additional items, I recommend the Salmon Sashimi (similar to Tuna Sashimi that comes with Trust Me but slightly different seasoning), Scallop Sushi, and Sweet Shrimp Sushi (HIGHLY recommend this one). In the 5+ times I've been, their service is also consistently great, which is a big plus!

I loved their Los Angeles location.. This one, not so much. I see the value in their pricing but what pushed us over the edge was one of the fishes they served had tiny bones in it.  This isn't good!

I'm sorry but we don't think we'll go back there again.  We'll stick to their Los Angeles location when we're there next time.  Too bad because their customer service level is actually on point, very quick in getting back to us and all.

Incredible as always. Had only eaten as SoHo location before ... flatiron does not disappoint. Fish and flavors all incredible and the service was excellent. 

Also very clean and well handled with COVID.

- Food: great for this price point. Fish is always incredibly fresh, slightly seasoned to enhance natural flavors. I recommend one of the omakase options
- Service: is fantastic - staff is always courteous and very attentive

In my opinion, this is probably the best bang for your buck omakase place in NYC - very solid food that will not destroy your wallet. Always a great experience dining here.

Disappointed!!!!!

I've been frequenting all the locations of the restaurant for a long time.  But for tonight, I am extremely disappointed.  

I arrived at the restaurant reception today around 9 pm, put my name on the list and the hostess  assured me that in about 40 minutes I would receive a message and my table would be ready.  

It was then that my best friend and I went to another bar, where by the way, we were treated extremely well, and we were having a drink and waiting for the text message from Sugarfish. 

 When it was 10:30 I was STARVIN, and decided to go back to the Sugarfish reception...

Result: THEY FORGOT ME!  THEY FORGOTTEN TO SEND ME MESSAGE, WITHOUT ANY EXCUSE, THERE WERE VACANT PLACES, BUT THEY SAID THERE WAS NO MORE TIME TO SIT US! SUCH A SHAME.  

Just me, who recommend the restaurant to all my friends and customers!  

Result: I WILL NEVER BE BACK AGAIN!!!
Love the food . It's one of my fav restaurants for sushi in the city . I usually go to the location on midtown west . The hostess is a little curd but I just go for the food .

My husband and I always love eating here but let me tell you. This review is specifically Jewel, she works in the Flatiron location. 

She's never served me before but she is seriously the best server we've ever had. She anticipates my needs. She recommends the best sushi and honestly 10 out of 5 star service. She is the best. 

Ask to be served by Jewel because she is the best and honestly if you want to know the best thing to order - she got you.
Super tasty and will 10/10 go again. Felt very nice to sit inside a restaurant and have a great experience. Wait wasn't super long. Maybe 45 minutes so we walked around and shopped while we waited
Such good sushi and the curated boxes are filling and a good deal. It's very fresh. The lobster roll is delish!

COVID-19 indoor dining review: I came to Sugarfish when they first opened years ago and wasn't super impressed, but was compelled to come back here after having such an amazing experience at the Santa Monica location a few years back. Recently came for a work lunch and sat inside: we both got the Trust Me set and also added on the eel nigiri and a scallop hand roll, since we were still slightly hungry at the end of the meal. Overall, it was an easy and satisfying lunch experience. I found the fish to be very fresh and the rice hot, perfectly cooked, and well seasoned. The fish/sauce pairings obviously aren't as well-balanced or as out there as what you'd find at a typical omakase, but for the price, it's well worth the money. Would definitely come back, and also want to try Kazunori, as the hand rolls were my favorite part of the meal.
Speaking as someone who has been to mesa, thier prefix menu was very tasty and well worth the money.

Loved the trust me menus. Went with the second from top option compared to the don't think just eat option. Could not ask for more! The fish was excellent and the service was wonderful. Items came out quickly and were very fresh. Hand rolls were a great touch, especially the crab. Loved the no tip environment and the green tea we got.
Personalized and great-tasting service....never disappoints. Their choices of fish with the personalized sauces (so no need for typical soy-sauce) are out of this world.

Came here right around the time indoor dining came back in NYC (to meet coworkers I had never met in person before!). We did the online reservation thing, and it was pretty easy to get a time that worked for us on a weeknight.

They have a big outdoor seating, and all their booths are available inside (with plastic dividers in between).

We all did the Nozawa Trust Me, which included:
-Edamame
-Tuna sashimi
-Albacore sushi
-Salmon sushi
-New Zealand Sea Bream Sushi
-Toro hand roll
-Japanese yellowtail sushi
-Sea bass sushi
-Blue and Dungeness crab hand roll
-and the daily special (scallop when we went)

For $52 (gratuity included), that's one hell of a deal!

My favorite was the sea bream, and the crab roll. The tuna sashimi in ponzu was also good. Everything else was good, but nothing to write home about.

Staff was great. Would return again!

Amazing service and amazing food. Everything comes very quickly. Highly recommend the Omakase menu. The sushi is so fresh and the warm rice tops off the delicious food. This is my favorite sushi place and it never disappoints. I wish they had Sugarfish closer to my area!

The thing I love about sugarfish no matter when you eat here they are consistently tasty and the service is always high class. They have amazing different levels of omakase (お任せ) that really won't break you bank and usually satisfies everyone having them.

This place gets busy very quickly and early so it is highly recommended to scan the QR on the door in advance to get queued up since they are first come first service otherwise you might be waiting a few hours.

Now have outdoor dining as well, so it doubles the amount of space for this already kinda smallish restaurant had which is very exciting!

TLDR: not the best sushi I've ever had but for the price, it's pretty amazing

I finally tried Sugarfish and it didn't disappoint! I got the Dont Think, Just Eat set and it cost around $65 (tip was included)! This set came with 14 pieces of nigiri, 2 hand rolls and 1 plate of sashimi. Some of the nigiri highlights were the salmon, tuna and albacore. Those were my favorite of the night but honorable mention goes to the hand rolls. I believe that the items included in the set change and it's more of a chefs choice style. The quantity doesn't seem huge but by the end of dinner, I was soooo full! 

The ambience was so cute and perfect for a date night or a girls night out. The servers were really great as well and came often to refill drinks and bring more ginger/wasabi. They also did an amazing job of explaining the different types of sets and ways to eat the sushi. I get the hype and can't wait to go back! 

We did come on a Wednesday and the wait was around ~30 minutes. They have a system where you go in and put your name down and when your table is ready then they'll text you!

This is the second time this has happened: I place my order (all items are available on the menu) and shortly after--maybe 10 minutes--I get a text: "The restaurant is out of items you ordered. Respond within 10 minutes or they may cancel your order". So I respond to the text--immediately, asking which items are not available. No answer. I re-check the app--everything is still available. So there's no way to know what they've run out of, and within 10 minutes I'm informed by text that the order is canceled.
I don't know if this is a Sugarfish or a Postmates problem--there's no "contact us" function on the app. Too bad, because the sushi is very good--but I'll never order from either Sugarfish or Postmates again.

Finally went to the 33 E 20th St location today
easy seating @ 1pm .. no wait   the place was cool and peaceful 

Ordered the Don't Think Just Eat Trust me
Really good quality sushi - The server was very professional - never hovering but always there if you needed a refill or ready for the next course
She also did a very good job of explaining the plate and recommending how to eat it..

Will definitely be back ..often

Trust Me Lite/Nicaea either or you can't go wrong. Anything on this menu is bomb. The tuna sashimi starter in a bowl is incredible. Their secret sauce is their lemon zesty ponzu sauce that's drenched on half the sushi in the mini Trust Me omakase order, and it is delicious!

This place was so unique! We're so glad to have visited this place in NYC. The staff were extremely friendly. We all purchased the Nozawa Trust Me and it was awesome. The fish were all high quality to the point where it melted in our mouths. I would highly recommend coming here and ordering the Trust Me series. For 52 bucks, it was a pretty great overall experience.

Ok, my seven year old and I love sushi. Sugarfish was our first stop in the city. We heard great things from friends and wanted to check out the hype! 

They definitely delivered on the HYPE! EVERYTHING WAS SO DELICIOUS!

We got the Trust Me Nozawa $48 & an extra salon roll $12.75 to share. This is also a no tipping establishment, so the price includes all fees.

The trust me started with edamame, and then the portions come out one after another once you are done with each. 

The fish was definitely top 3 that I've ever had. So delicious and buttery. Soft but not mushy. No hard chewing! The only downside I had was that the rice wasn't sticky enough because it kept falling apart. But that didn't take away from taste. We liked it so much,  we ordered take out the next day!

I don't eat a lot of sushi so I was hesitant to spend the cash at the famed Sugarfish.  I was extremely fortunate to receive a "To-Go Trust Me" bento box at work for a client meeting, and suddenly I UNDERSTOOD THE HYPE!  The fish was so so fresh, and melted in your mouth.  While the box has instructions on how to best pair each fish with the sauce options, it was difficult to distinguish each fish and I know I definitely did a few things wrong.  

A few days later, I dined in with a friend and WOW!  The experience in-person is delightful.  First, we arrived around 11:30 to beat the crowd, and was seated immediately.  I again ordered the "Trust Me" lunch option and they serve each fish already prepped with the recommended sauce and toppings, so that you don't have to add any on top.  I loved this as I was able to experience each bite exactly as the chef wanted.  The menu is also slightly different than the to-go option, as it includes hand rolls (these are meant to be eaten immediately, else the seaweed will go soggy). 

In addition, the meal was much more affordable than I thought, especially for high quality fish.  I also appreciate that Sugarfish is a no tipping restaurant - everything is already baked into the price.  Looking forward to my next meal here!

BELIEVE the hype.

I went for lunch for my birthday and I have to say it was one of the best sushi experiences of my life. 

I got the $65 menu and it really is a nice big healthy amount of sushi for that price. Various hand rolls, nigiri, sashimi, and more. 

The difference between this place and your standard sushi spot is pretty apparent right out of the gate. Each piece of fish simply melts, literally, MELTS in your mouth. Each piece of nigiri is served over the most delightfully fluffy and warm sushi rice. Each hand roll is a work of art with satisfying crunch through the wrap into the aforementioned melting rice and fish.

This is now officially on the short list for special occasion spots for me. It's really just out of this world. Go go GO!

I've been here a couple of times. It lives up to the hype and is definitely the best sushi experience I've ever had in America. However they do it, they seem to take sushi to the next level. The seaweed is crispier, the rice is grainier, the fish tastes unreal.

We did get takeout the last time and can only recommend eating it right away. We had waited half an hour and it already tasted vastly different.

If you have time to spare, I think the hour wait is worth it - not sure if I would wait longer than that just because I don't have the patience especially since they expect you to wait there so you can't really run out to do anything else. But their fish quality was amazing and each bite was so fresh and the price tag was very surprising for the excellent quality. Would definitely recommend this for affordable yet exceptional quality fish. There is also no tipping since the gratuity is all included which is even more surprising since I've definitely paid more for lower sushi grade fish.

The dimly lit mainstreamish sushi spot is a solid neighborhood restaurant for locals and pre-gaming partiers alike. Late night eaters who want quick sushi in a louder, energetic environment could consider this a default.

This is somewhere I would take a friend who is averse to adventurous eating, but still likes sushi. Likely before we go drinking elsewhere.

Nigiri-wise, their rice has been a bit undercooked, too warm, and falls apart a little quickly. Their taste parings are very on point, especially their scallops and yellowtail. Their eel nigiri is also one of the better eel nigiri I've tasted. I also appreciate how they suggest which nigiri should be eaten without additional sauces. 

Their later hours (for sushi) and good service is also a plus.

Consistently amazing sushi. Though once you've been there as many times as we have, it's not the most "innovative" as the menu doesn't change- you still know that you will always have amazing quality sushi here. Never a bad experience. Always at the top of their game when it comes to their food and service.

I was just here last night with my bf and we ordered two don't think, just eat courses ($65 each). We sat down at the bar and started off our course with edamame and then another couple sat down and they ordered two trust me courses ($55 each). They also briefly got their edamame. About 10 min goes by and we all got our tuna sashimi. Another 15 min goes by and the couple next to us each gets 6 pieces of good looking sashimi pieces. My bf even noted how it was weird that they got their food before us when we sat down first. We then saw the waitresses get confused as they were about to bring two more plates over to that same couple. A waitress approached them and was like oh these pieces you just got aren't actually yours but it's on the house and proceeds to gives them their trust me pieces. Then she approaches us and just says sorry, nothing else. 

At this point, we were starving and slightly hangry (I mean, wouldn't you be too??!) lol. We had to wait another 15 min to get the pieces we should've gotten. We eventually got all that was described in the don't think, just eat course but we were just disappointed with the service. The servers weren't genuinely apologetic and didn't say anything else to us after the incident. For the $10 extra that me and my bf each had to pay for our courses, another couple benefited from it. It's a shame because I've had such good experiences at other Sugarfish locations in NYC and in the west coast. Hopefully management reads this and improves how they handle situations like this.
Delicious, elegant service, simple "Trust Me" combo choices. I will come back!! Often when in town!! Best item was the crispy seaweed fatty tuna hand roll. Mmmmmmmm.

Sugarfish is always a hit, no matter which location. Service was fantastic and the fish always melts in your mouth. We grabbed a couple pieces here tonight as we had eaten earlier. The Salmon is honestly the best fish they serve and I would definitely recommend it if ordering a la carte items. The Tuna Sashimi is also a favorite. You really can't go wrong with anything on their menu.

The service is very good here, and it gets very busy at lunch or dinner time. The tables are super close to each other which is kinda made me a bit uncomfortable especially during pandemic, mask is not required and no temperature check nor vaccination verification either despite the rising covid variant cases. I'm sitting like 2 ft away from the next table. I don't think I will come back again until they have more strict protocol. 

Food is good, everything is a little bit over citric and acidic. Some white fish pieces only had some salt on top that doesn't not bring out the flavor of the fish, it tastes very blend. The fish itself are very fresh but without the condiments it doesn't not bring out the best of the flavor. And we both ordered the don't think trust me which is $65/pp but it only just has two extra shrimp nigiri, we thought it would get more surprises since there's no menu but what a disappointment. 

This place has so much potential but all to the wrong places, rice is too much vinegar, fish has no flavor. Gratitude is included which is very nice

Great experience and great food! I had the trust me dinner menu $55 around 12 pieces plus edamame & tuna sashimi. The quality of the fish was great, all the flavors and textures too. The special of the day was anago (eel) and was incredible! 

They are a NO tipping restaurant, honoring Japan's culture, meaning they actually pay good salaries to their employees. Bravo! So you pay what the menu says plus tax. Giving a great example for the restaurant industry. Oh, and service was espectacular. 

Make sure to form online in the virtual waiting list because it takes about 2 hours to get a table on a weekend night, we joined the list around 7.30pm and got our table around 9.15pm. The ambiance was great and the servers too because they allow you to enjoy the meal without rushing you and explained very patiently everything we asked. 

Cannot wait to come back!

I would give it a zero if it were possible.  The food was fine.  Not spectacular, but high quality.  The wait was absurd, but as advertised.  So, won't complain about that. The problem is the completely unacceptable, dismissive service by the entitled millennial staff.  I have eaten out 3 - 4 nights a week for the past 30 years, and have never seen anything like it.  Honestly, never.  I could go on and on, but will keep it to one anecdote.  The edamame was bland, so we asked for salt.  The server's response:  "Sorry, we don't give out extra salt."  It was so outrageous that I didn't know what to say.  It's a restaurant! No salt?   Beyond bad service, more like "F you".  When the $200 bill arrived, service was included.  I know why.  There are 10 better sushi restaurants within a 10 block radius.  Do yourself a favor.

I came here with my coworkers for lunch and had a good time! I ordered the "Trust Me" lunch special which is a really good deal for the quality sushi you're getting. It's not omakase, where you're literally sitting in front of the chef making it for you, but they do make it fresh to order and you can tell. 

The rice is still a bit warm, the fish doesn't have any freezer burn, it doesn't have any bad scent, and the the rice to fish ratio is pretty good too! I will say though, don't expect to be full! I'd consider this a light lunch. 

This is a no tipping restaurant which is great, even though the service is really good. It was packed for lunch but our server took really good care of us, was very attentive and quick to bring out each round.

I was surprised at how busy it was on a weekday lunch but clearly people know it's pretty good. I'd recommend if you're trying to find a good quality sushi place without breaking the bank, and definitely take advantage of the lunch prices!

So happy we were able to return to SugarFish while visiting NYC! Honestly it's just so delicious and fresh. Small intimate menu and the restaurant is beautiful. Sitting at the bar is my favorite- staff is friendly and knowledgeable. Till next time!

It was really good for the price. I def recommend it. I know 3 star might sound low but it's just a very good 3 star restaurant with really good service and the best part is that the tip is included! 
They don't take reservations so be ready for a long wait specially in the weekend.

My first time ever trying the infamous SUGARFISH and it did not disappoint! After seeing endless photos and videos of people eating here and getting that iconic take-out box of sushi, I've been dying to try this place to see what the hype is. 

Came for dinner and there was still a wait for a party of 2 on a Monday at 9pm. Make sure to join the online waitlist if you want to dine in. We waited for about 30-45 minutes before being seated at the bar. 

We ordered the Trust Me ($41) which comes with: edamame, tuna sashimi, albacore + salmon sushi, toro hand roll, yellowtail + sea bream + sea bass sushi, and a crab hand roll. Great value for the quality of the fish and presentation! 

The sushi here isn't as mind blowing or fresh as it is at an actual omakase restaurant or higher end sushi establishment, but I still thought the flavor and preparation of each part of the set was really good for the price (only $41 since they do not take tip). My favorites were the tuna sashimi with ponzu and chives and the crab hand roll. 

Service was fast and attentive but it did feel like they were slightly rushing us to eat and leave since they were so busy. I'd like to try their infamous pretty takeout box next time so maybe that won't be an issue :-)
5/5. Significantly outshines many $150+ omakase places I've been to. In my experience, this location is also better than the uptown location
The fish is of the highest quality. The rice is well-executed. That is everything I'm looking for in a sushi place.

Start off by saying sushi is amazing !  Next thing is the manager on Sunday is nasty is disrespectful and don't care about taking care of the customer. I didn't know she was running a Nobu type of restaurant. I have been to all locations and this manager is horrible. Arrogant and again cares nothing about her customers. Not sure if this is the way corporate trained her.  Go and enjoy the great sushi but ignore the Sunday manager for sure !

Best sushi I've had in NY. Visiting from DC, so I appreciate that the restaurant checked our vaccination cards. 

Service was excellent and the fish was extremely fresh & high quality. We did not try any Trust Me omakase options, but ordered a la carte instead and was not disappointed. My only surprise was that the medium fatty tuna (chutoro) was better than the otoro...my otoro was too sinewy (instead of fully melting in my mouth). 

The edamame is really the size for one person (we ended up ordering two). The ikura (salmon roe) was as if right out of the fish. You can tell the difference. 

I also like that you can add yourself to the waitlist online (if there is one), and you receive text updates. Will def be back again!
Amazing meal!   Get on the virtual waiting list. Definitely worth searching out and enjoying a great sushi experience.

Extremely affordable sushi! Decent quality! Great spot for a quick and casual lunch. No reservations and no tipping. 

Great value, the "trust me" option on the menu is only $41 for several pieces of nigiri and a handroll. There aren't many other places in the city that offer such competitive pricing along with good quality fish

Great food and a great haven for dog owners, but not so much if you care about the health code - their policy is "don't ask don't tell" if someone brings a dog into their restaurant - which translates into "rich people can do what they like" - who knows what other health code violations they are willing to incur in the interests of convenience.

Really wish that I had taken some photos!!
It was a bit dark inside to take a nice photo. But the food was A++++. I would definitely recommend this place for just nice clean omakase.

Good quality fish at quality value. HOWEVER, we ended up getting a smaller Trust Me than the ones that we ordered (we wanted the big one), so ended up leaving the restaurant hungry. =( Knocking off one star for miscommunication - they should really clarify the Trust Mes

Sugarfish is a chain restaurant which I know from LA before they moved to NYC. Sugarfish is always a treat in LA, and my favorite is just getting the trust me boxes to go and eating it in bed or lounging (literally me and all of Instagram). I feel like the NYC version is, while should be the same, feels paired down, and pricing is slightly higher. I got the "don't think, just trust me" which I've had once before in LA, and I think it was less than what I got in LA--in LA I was uncomfortably full, but in NYC I was barely satisfied. Others got the same but some got the regular trust me and I don't think we got that much compared to the regular trust me's? The eel as a daily special felt not worth but they didn't bother telling us the daily special so we wouldn't have known unless we asked specifically. The rice fell apart and wasn't tight enough to hold for picking up, for some of our pieces. They were really good at being careful for allergies and brought allergy free dishes out alone. Also did pretty well (for a while at least) explaining each fish option. After the last course we sat for a really long time, making unsure if the courses were done or if more was coming, but nothing else was coming we were just unattended for a long time, overall was fine, but definitely prefer LA experience.

I am shocked it took me this long to post a review of this place. I was introduced to it by my fiancé a few months ago and it quickly became one of my favorite and most frequented restaurants. Don't bother with a la cart and just get the trust me. Everything is made with super fresh ingredients and it all just melts in your mouth and bursts with flavor.

One of my favorite sushi spots in NYC. This location is better than the other two city spots in my opinion. Great service but they don't take reservations so be ready to wait. I like to go during the late afternoon when it's not too busy so I don't feel rushed. The sushi is top notch and so fresh, and the little sakes are awesome!

Let me just start off by saying I am not a big sushi person... and after this meal, I've officially changed my views!

Came here for a special occasion, my boyfriend's birthday, and the waitress was very friendly and attentive. Service was great. Food was even better! Got the "Trust Me" and I highly recommend it. Every piece of sushi was super fresh and tasted so delicious with every bite.

I would definitely come back and I would even try the new location that opened up at Midtown East!

Didn't even take photos because of how good the meal itself and food was!!!

Amazing place, food, quality and hospitality.
The Sake was great, food cost/quality really good.

Classically high quality fish and dining experience. Situated in a plain building, be sure to plan your  trip and get there early since they fill up immediately and don't take reservations. I still had to wait an hour after calling ahead on a Thursday night. Service was incredibly friendly and helpful throughout, and little tidbits on the menu and procedures explained on how to eat the fish heightened the experience. I ordered the classic trust me, and the fish was very high quality and fresh. The tuna and hand rolls stick out as especially delicious. I'd put the food quality and uniqueness a small step below the likes of Zuma. I came extremely hungry, and was a little disappointed to not leave full after a $43 tasting meal. Overall, it was a good experience but there's so many other high quality, expensive sushi spots in New York for me to go again anytime soon.

Really good handrolls! Wish they had more options though. 
I ordered the smallest Trust Me tasting and was surprisingly satisfied. The yellowtail and sea bream sushi was not the freshest but all other fishes were.  The sushi I got was also really good in size, bigger than normal. They are more on the basic side where its mainly the fish over sushi rice and minimal sauce which is a great place for people who don't normally have sushi, to start trying things.
Would definitely come back for the handrolls!!

Trash service. I attempted to go here for dinner with my wife. Numerous tables open and available yet they turned us away. The very rude hostess said there were 9 parties ahead of us yet not a soul waiting inside or outside.

Obsessed with this brand! Went for the first, second, and third time in one week in LA (don't judge me, I'm a creature of habit lol) and been hooked ever since. The staff is always very pleasant and I wonder if it's because it's a no tipping establishment and they're well taken care of. The ambiance is always relaxing and peaceful and the food is so good and fresh. They just get it. I love the Nozawa trust me, it's great to not have to think too much about ordering since it's a prefix coursed menu. It's become my fave sushi spot. Hopefully one comes to BK soon.

Wow wow this place was great. If you're looking for a more upscale, non takeout sushi place, this is your spot.

Got the "Trust Me" set meal which comes with about 7 courses for $37. The $37 already has tip baked into it. The sushi was so tender and flavorful, I was content by the end of it. Fair price and amount of food. Would go back, eager to try their omakase.

Wow! 

This was my first experience trying sushi (I mean real sushi, raw fish) so worth it. From the beginning everting was just delicious. I didn't like the scallop, and it was just me for the texture. But every piece was so good.

This place never disappoints. I usually get one of the suggested "trust me" options, but this time I wanted to try other nigiri that wasn't included.

I had the sea bream, kampachi, chutoro, scallop and ebi.  The only thing I would not re-order was the scallop.  It had a bit too much soy and could have used a burst of favor. 

For drinks, I get their house bottled sake when I go.  It's one of my favorites.  

I also had an order to-go, that included albacore belly, o-toro, sweet shrimp and kampachi.  The packaging has everything separated with wasabi and sauces packaged individually - however, in order to figure out  the pairings, I had to go to their website.  

This is a great beginner place to get higher end vs your basic sushi spot with a California roll lunch special.  I must warn you though, it is very hard to go back to basic sushi after this.  

Enjoy!
always the best! The service is great besided the wait but its well worth it. fish is butter and melts in youre mouth. Its always my go to for sushi.

Trendy as hell but I can't stop coming back. The "trust me" never disappoints. I learned about Sugarfish in LA and sushi can be hit or miss in this neighborhood. High bar customer service and though I'm sure they see a million faces here it is nice to get that small business vibe in terms of recognition. *****.

This was the best sushi I've ever tasted. I'm not one to eat nigiri unless it's coated in soy sauce, and I barely used any the entire time. My husband and I both ordered the Don't Think Just Eat Trust Me. (The biggest Omakase style tasting menu option.) 
It was a little too much food for me, but the hubs gladly ate everything I couldn't. And the price is the most reasonable you'll find for such high quality sushi. Even the rice is amazing, it literally melts in your mouth. This will definitely become a regular date night spot for us. Heads up- they get busy fast. We showed up at 5pm on a Tuesday and we were seated immediately, but by the time we finished, the restaurant was totally full and there was a big waitlist. Get there early unless you're okay with waiting, but I promise it's worth the wait regardless. 
(Oh! The salmon sashimi with roasted sesame seeds is the best salmon I've ever had. Next time I'm gonna get an entire cut roll of it. SO good)

Tried twice, first time got Trust Me and second time got The Nozawa Trust Me. Both times pretty filling for two people and reasonably priced. Fresh sashimi and sushi. Speedy service. Interesting instructions on what sauce to use for different types of fish served. Delicious and will continue to come back for their sushi.

The freshest sushi/sashimi I ever had by far. 
Not so exotic or oriental as I hoped for. Service was fast but also a bit pushy - it's a very busy place though so I probably get why. 
The space was ok... would prefer bigger space or tables further apart. 

I would visit again w a friend who wants to do this as an experience. Not for everyday

SUGARFISH is probably one of the best bang for your buck omakase sushi spots you'll come across in NYC. When I come here with friends I usually get the 'Trust Me,' it's the cheapest, but it's so tasty. The staff are so kind and accommodating so you can be rest assured that you're in good hands. I'm definitely going to start venturing out in their menu because I can only imagine how great the rest of their food options are!

This is my go to take out sushi spot. Sometimes I will get one of the preset boxes or I will create my own, but everything I've ordered has always been fresh, delicious and well packaged. The lobster roll is my favorite.

Great inexpensive prefixed menu with super fresh ingredients and tasty fish. Nothing super exciting but it's a great casual spot where you can have a quick sushi meal. I loved this place when I first discovered them in Santa Monica CA and was happy to see they've expanded to the east coast.
Such a deal for quality sushi. Tasting menu is well worth the price. Great service too.

I've gotten takeout from here a few times. My overall take is, the sushi is good, but not amazing. Prices are mid tier; they approach but don't reach omakase levels, and it's not quite omakase quality fish. Part of what you pay for is the really cute and fun packaging (which is most fun the very first time) and the generous portions. So it's a fun treat - I've gotten it for special occasions for myself and for others, but when I want really high quality sushi, I don't think it quite hits the spot.

Had a great experience here! We tried their "trust me" specials and it was perfect. I only wish we didn't get full so fast and we're able to enjoy further. The service and hospitality is above and beyond here. Servers are really amazing and are on top of everything collectively. The ambiance is perfect for an intimate date. Definitely give this spot a try, you won't regret it.

As far as sushi goes, I trust them with my life. The Trust Me is a staple--while it isn't entirely filling, it does satisfy every craving you'll have. I usually go once a month and every time it does not disappoint. While all of their fish is high quality, their yellowtail in particular is a standout.

Came in on a Saturday night around 6pm and waited approximately 1 hour for a table for two. Heard a lot about Sugarfish and was curious about the hype given the simplicity of the sushi here. My fiancé and I both got the Don't Think Just Eat ($65) which included a sashimi appetizer, 14 pieces of nigiri and 2 hand rolls. It was so worth the price and we were so full afterwards! Each piece was simple, clean and the texture of the fish were all "melt in your mouth." We both enjoyed our meals and was pleasantly surprised!

Excellent sushi, all around, by the masters at Sugar fish. If you've been to one of their other locations in LAX or other cities, you know you're in for a high end, delicious, and awesome meal. Sugarfish is great for a date, a business meal, and feeling fancy with friends. It's a little dark and moody in here, but in a trendy way.

Ugh. Love this place so much. Vibe on point. Food is even better. Omakase is a must. Service was kind of weird as our server left midway and left us questioning if our course was completed. Aside from that would definitely go back!

Such a good quality and fresh sushi/sashimi with Omakase style yet the prices are extremely reasonable (tips inclusive)
We ordered the highest " Don't think just eat". 
We really had no time to think as we were thoroughly enjoyed the foods. 
The wait can be super long in the peak hours but you could wait upstairs. I wish they have a separate bar for drinks so we can enjoy the drinks while waiting.

Wow, glad I stumbled upon this spot! I had heard about it some years ago, but never found myself in the area, that changed yesterday.

I love the simplicity of the menu, and the different levels of Omakase available. I chose the mid level one, which included about six pieces of sushi, a small bowl of sashimi, and two hand rolls. For me, this was perfect for a light lunch. 

At $40, it was a tad pricey for that amount of food, but I must honestly say, this fish was of incredible quality, way better than most of my local sushi joints. You definitely will not mistake the food you get here for strip mall sushi! And another thing to bear in mind, even though the price might be a bit high, this place has a no tipping policy, so that needs to be factored in as well. 

Great service, great ambience, and wonderful Omakase. High-quality fish, vibrant flavors, and good presentation.
