I know this place has been around quite a while, but if you haven't taken the time to get there like me, don't wait any longer!

Cannot say how much I love Sugarfish for what they strive to be, and how well they deliver that vision.

There is such a character of Chef Nozawa at Sugarfish, even though he obviously doesn't run any of them in person. Despite the staff being completely unrelated from the original great chef, the ideology lives on, and you can feel it. From the ambiance, which is already a rustic-industrial combo, to the extremely bright kitchen, and then candles everywhere, to the detail -- oh man the detail is astounding. Everything from which soap to use to wash your hand before/after eating, to which pieces of fish to use sauces on, and the order of eating. Going to Sugarfish seems like you're having a DIY omakase, with Chef Nozawa's manual by your side. Even the menu gives really cool intros into why fish and rice are prepared certain ways.

For the food, the fish is a medium plus amount. It's a bit more than you'd get at a normal place. And some of the fish are really special. They marinate a lot of their fish, or apply sauces, and somehow treat the fish so that some pieces like Yellowtail are softer or fattier than you'd expect. 

The sushi rice is also worth talking about, since Nozawa prides on having very distinctive soft, breaking apart and melting in your mouth type rice. And it definitely does that. In fact, you might be better off using your hands to eat your sushi (I'm sure I'm not the only one?), so you can grab on the sushi when you pick it up.

Their drinks are quite limited, if I had to nitpick something. But that's because the shop is so standardized, and they are focusing all their effort on the fish. I don't mind, because they have a $25 corkage fee, which is very generous and lets you bring almost anything without feeling bad. The sushi at Sugarfish tends to be a bit more flavorful, so a more full bodied sake is a great choice, and even aged if you're feeling adventurous.

I finally managed to try sugarfish after several previous unsuccessful attempts. If you come for dinner, you're almost guaranteed going to wait at least an hour; I showed up for lunch at around 1pm and was seated immediately. 

I like how simple yet effective sugarfish makes it. No tipping culture, no over the top presentation or unnecessary gimmicks. I tried the "Dont think. Just eat" option which is priced at $67; I thought it was worth the price. The quality of the fish is good and it was a very satisfying meal. The courses come out relatively quick so the entire experience lasted maybe 30-45 minutes or so. 

Was a solid experience and worth the hype/popularity.

We came for lunch and got the omakase (tasting) which included nigiri, sashimi, and handrolls. Overall the fish was so fresh and the rice was to die for. My only sticking point is the dishes that included ponzu sauce were just so salty and the lime was very strong.

Food was incredible but I had to give a 1 star rating for the customer service. After waiting 2.5 hours for a table I sat down at a table for 3 with only 2 people and was left with an extra empty chair. I asked MY MOTHER to join us because we had an extra chair and when she arrived at the restaurant they told her "sorry you cannot be seated at their table because they had requested a reservation for 2." Even though she was not ordering any food and she was simply asking to sit at our table which already had an empty 3rd set available. Absolutely ridiculous after spending $200 on sushi.

This is not really a $$$$ restaurant since the price is already including tips. I would say probably $$ to $$$ instead. 

The seating area was pretty dark and noisy. The service was pretty good given there is no tipping system. 

The food was good and I definitely would recommend and come back again.

I was so excited to try sugar fish as so many of my friends sing praise of this chain. I don't know if it's cause it was really busy (we waited over 2 hours for a seat) or the chef is new but the sushi was extremely subpar.

Our waitress was new so it was understandable that some mistakes were made and they were very accommodating and wanted to make things right.

However, the sushi rice was extremely vinegary and overpowered the fish. It was extremely disappointing considering the wait time and price.
Absolutely worth the hype. Delicious, fresh, melt in your mouth sushi. This is a no tipping restaurant with great service. Highly recommend

I've been here a lot of times and just realized on a random day and time that I at least owe them a review. 

First of all, this is by far my favorite sushi spot in the five boroughs. When you have a craving for sushi please do me a favor and come here. Do not waste your time going to a random sushi spot and order something rudimentary such as a California roll. 

If you come here order the "trust me". You will be served a series of hand rolls, sushi and sashimi. Please be open minded if this is outside your comfort zone. You will notice the difference as fresh fish should not taste fishy but buttery (in some cases), with subtle tastes of sea-water. I assure you that the tasting is worth it, it's affordable and will keep you full. 

My favorites include their yellowtail sushi, tuna sashimi and toro hand roll. Wash it down with their house sake that is on the dry spectrum, but hits the spot. If you are not into alcohol the iced green tea is refreshing. 

I have not had any of their desserts  as I always end up so full! 

One more thing is that their staff is superb. They make the experience worthwhile.

Pro tip: they don't take reservations, waiting times vary, usually dinner time is the busiest. However, go upstairs and have a drink in their waiting area. If not you can walk around and they'll shoot you a text when your table is made available.
I love that they deliver (postmates)! Perfect lunch option when I'm working at my company's HQ. Consistent quality, expect an hour delivery time min.

It would be easier to eat here if they took reservations but if you don't want any wait time, then it's best to show up when it opens.  I got the Trust Me which was the perfect portion for lunch.  Everything was timed well.  The sushi tasted fresh and came with some good sauces, like ponzu.
The food is fresh and yummy.  The servers are attentive.  There is not much distance between each table.

A no brainer if you're looking to enjoy an incredible meal of sushi. There are a few options for what you can get - you can order a la carte but I'd highly recommend selecting one of the "Trust me" courses. We all got The Nozawa Trust Me and each course was amazing - especially the hand rolls and Albacore. It is a lot more food than you would think and it got pretty tough to finish out the last few rounds. Fresh and quick service as well. Plus we walked in on a Saturday evening and we're able to get seated right away. Overall, great experience and eager to return!

After several attempts to dine here we arrived earlier in the day this time and were seated right away. Can't recall which service we ordered but it was the largest option. The food and service were both very nice, we really enjoyed the presentation order as we're regularly fast eaters and this prevented that, which is another good thing about this place. Enjoyed SugarFish and will be back.

All the reviews are correct. Especially in NYC, you just won't find a better omakase deal for the portions/quality/ambiance. If there is one I'd love to know. Always on the search for reasonable omakase. Also a huge fan of their blue crab roll. Only downside is no reservations but we're fine with that. We plan for the wait and have drinks somewhere else. Or do takeout. Love the focused menu. If you're GF like me, note that they totally accommodate, but do NOT have Tamari. We bring our own :-)

We came here for dinner on a weekday and it was bustling! Fortunately, we were able to get seated by the bar. My friend and I ordered the Nozawa Trust Me and were quite satisfied, adding only an additional order. 

We started off with some salted edamame beans, served in their pods. Next came the tuna sashimi, seasoned in ponzu. It was good, nothing spectacular. The trio nigiri came next, with two pieces each of albacore tuna, sea bream, and salmon. The albacore tuna was very fatty and delicious, though the rice was loosely packed and fell apart shortly. 

The toro handroll came after and it was so fatty! One of my favourite bites of the evening - overall, I found the handrolls to be delicious with the warm rice against the super crispy seaweed. You definitely need to eat it while still fresh. Another trio of nigiri soon followed, with bluefin otoro, sea bream, and hotate (scallop). The cold scallop was subtly sweet but its flavour was overpowered by the vinegary rice. I found that eating it separate helped to preserve the flavours better. The sea bream had a nice chew, and the otoro was good albeit slightly sinewy. 

The blue and Dungeness crab hand roll came last. This was my favourite, just leading the other hand roll by a small margin. The crab was very sweet and warm, and mayo helped elevate the flavours slightly. My friend ordered an extra unagi nigiri to round the meal off and that was delicious too. 

A great meal! Not perfect with some loose rice and heavier flavours, but still good.

YUM! I understand the hype. We walked in at 6ish on Tuesday night and were sat immediately! Although it's a tad noisy, we had a great time. The food was so delicious and fast! Definitely will be back.

This is better than 3 stars (at least 4 stars based on pricing alone) but I couldn't just couldn't justify adding in one additional star. Came here on a date and the ambiance was nice. I got the DON'T THINK. JUST EAT. TRUST ME which includes a couple pieces which are slightly different from the normal TRUST ME. Each piece/dish came out separately and we ultimately spent about 1 - 1.5 hours here. Stomach left feeling content. 

Note, tips are included into cost already.

No reservations, no tipping. This dimly lit restaurant is perfect for date night.
They are popular for their "trust me" menu which is a sampler style platter. The Trust me lite is perfect for one person. All the fish is extremely fresh, and plates come out as ready. The tuna sashimi was delicious, the perfect size for an appetizer. 
Last course is a have roll that is a decent size portion, best eaten right away while the seaweed is still crispy. Limited drink menu.

Amazing place to dine in if you are craving for sushi, I had raw fish for the first time, and it melted in my mouth (I avoided raw fish for food poisoning, but man this was so good). And the wasabi was so fresh, can't wait to go back there again!
so good!! love the trust me options, only thing is they refused to serve salmon with soy

cant believe its taken me this long to write a review but this place the loml

-flatiron location in particular is so understated and unassuming ez to miss, inside is sm dimmer and colder than all the other ones but I liek that lol
-I actually like that theres no reservations bc this place would be booked out 24/7 and id never get to eat here
-stopped by sat night 10pm got seated 1030, theres this asian spot right next door just grab some drinks at the bar there


-food u literally cant go wrong w anyth, but my faves are the blue crab hand roll and tuna sashimi. sweetness of the crab w the nuttiness of the rice and umami of the seaweed mmmm so perfect. tuna sashimi literally converted me as a diehard salmon fan..always thought tuna was too firm unless it was toro..not at sugarfish!! the citrusy ponzu/soy sauce it comes w is the most perfect balanced version of that type sauce

-alr alluded to this but apart from the fish, its the rice and seaweed that rly makes them the best..u can tell they care about every component !!

-TLDR if u have a sushi hater in ur life just bring them here. they be complaining abt how they're never full after sushi or whatnot...sugarfish is always so fresh and quality even the lightest set will fill u up. they also usually time each plate perfectly. ALSO SOOOOOOO WELL PRICED

This place is always super busy so if you're really hungry, I advise going somewhere else because the wait times are usually long! They also do not do reservations. 
For two people, we ended up waiting close to 2 hours for a table. Once seated, we decided to do two courses of the Nozawa Trust Me omakase.

It was really good and I definitely recommend it if you're hungry. I really appreciated that there were the lighter options too such as The trust me and Lite. That's great for people who don't want to eat as much or have a smaller appetite but still want a taste of fresh nigiri.

Everything that I was handed was devoured within a minute, so I only have one one picture. It was just too fresh, too delicious. I loved that the sushi rice was warm, it felt more comforting to eat. The sashimi was fresh and cut well. 

Everything was portioned correctly and I left the place feeling so satisfied!

Still excellent. But note we waited over 2hrs by a mistake the hostess made as they thought we were already seated.. ugh.  We were able to get bar seats around 10pm finally when we ran back and they did apologize. Thankfully quality is still top notch and service was excellent. We both ordered Trust Me ($43) tasting menu- it's the perfect balance of sashimi, sushi, and hand rolls. I'm glad I made it back finally but am absolutely going to be more attentive at looking at the text/waitlist link moving forward!
So fresh and consistently delicious every time. Every dish melts and your mouth and is also a great value for the money.  Every time I go I just want to go back right away.

Honestly, this is my favorite sushi place and I've been to so many sushi/omakase places. Sugarfish is affordable and delicious and fresh. I've never had a bad experience and the long wait is def worth it. I usually get the trust me or trust me lite. I decided to try the new toro combo appetizer and it was a little too fatty for me. 

I recommend coming for lunch when there's less people because it does get busy. If you're a regular, you can fill out the birthday card for a free meal on your birthday if you've been 2 or more times in that year. Honestly, a steal!

Went here on a weekday and waited around 10mins for a spot at the bar. 

They have a nice waiting area upstairs. The vibes are a mix of after work, friends, and date nights with the average person around having an above average fashion sense. Cool, modern industrial vibes. Our server was really nice and knowledgeable.  We got edamame and sushi- shrimp, sea bass, crab roll, and tuna tasting. Everything was absolutely amazing. My favorite was the medium fat tuna followed by the sea bass. 

Would recommend this place to anyone wanting a great sushi spot.

Sugarfish is one of those places that as a native New Yorker I was a bit resistant to try. It was well worth the hype. Removing one star because it took 2 hours to get a table. 

I got the $56 trust me omakase and everything was incredible except for the edamame that was a bit underwhelming and cold. I would also say that the crab hand roll at the end was a bit too heavy at the end. If I were to go back, I'd probably do the trust me lite!

Oh Sugarfish, I have missed you!! It's been a while, but I'm glad to see your sushi is still melt-in-your-mouth amazing. Tonight I had the "Trust Me" tasting menu. I trusted you and you didn't fail me. Standouts were the albacore and salmon. I just love the delicate way the fish is cut on top of the warm rice. Spectacular. I'm not a huge fan of the hand rolls. The seaweed paper is a little tough and hard to chew. Not only is the sushi amazing, the price is too! $43 for all that food? Hell yeah. I enjoyed my meal so much. Can't wait to come back!

I came here with my mentor for lunch per his recommendation for sushi. It was one of the best food experience I have had thus far in NY. The staff is very knowledgeable on each dish with a special care for explaining. It was a wonderful surprise to see each dish as they came out with how nice they were plated. 

I got a small course but, I wish I got the largest one. Things to note here, they do not take reservations. If you are doubtful that you can handle the largest course, I recommend still getting it. By the time I finish my entire set of dishes, I savored very piece and still felt a little hungry for more. I finished off with a green tea. The best meals are when you are enjoying the meal and miss good photos.

I love getting the Trust Me. It's great to have the items coursed out because everything stays so fresh. I love how they give tips for proper consumption/enjoyment with the menu. Every time I've come here I've been sat outside (probably because it was during the Covid peaks) so it was not very warm but regardless, still great. I can't imagine doing take out because the dine in experience makes it.

When in LA, I love to eat at Sugarfish. The staff will tell you that Chef Nozawa was able to build his empire of affordable omakase by making connections with local fishmongers in LA to get first choice of fresh, quality fish. That's what Sugarfish advertises for all of their 15 locations, including NYC, but I'm afraid it is untrue. While dining at Sugarfish in NYC, I tried my best to savor the seasoned pieces of sushi and hand rolls in the Nozawa Trust Me ($48 in NY, usually $39 in LA) but they were slightly off and not very different from the average, much more affordable sushi spot down the street. The fish was extremely cold, whereas at LA locations it arrives slightly chilled on warm rice providing a heightened flavor experience. The Chutoro, a usually rich, sweet and umami flavored fish was soggy and fishy, like tepid seawater. The end to my meal, the Blue and Dungeness Crab Hand Roll was the most disappointing. It tasted like canned crab from a dusty tin bought at the corner bodega. Maybe I was being overly critical but as that thought entered my mind, I saw the staff wheel in a bulk delivery of Chicken of the Sea brand canned crab and commercial Hellman's mayo into the kitchen and I realized I'm probably onto something. This isn't the great Sugarfish of LA, it's lower quality and more expensive, a cash grab for the trendy buyer. With a bill of $200 for a party of two at lunch, I can recommend many other local NYC spots that advertise and follow through on excellent, quality sushi and inexpensive omakase experiences.
Very good sushi and so are all the other dishes but the service is so so. The last time I came here, service was extremely slow, restaurant is a bit cramped.

Highly recommend this restaurant and location.
If you do come for lunch on a week day or weekend, try to arrive early. The same goes for dinner.

There normally is no wait  if I arrive at 11:45 or 2PM.

The "Trust Me" if always my go to. It has a variety of sushi and sashimi, and tastes fresh! The wait staff at this location are always polite and timely.

This is the albacore belly. My all time favorite thing to order Al a carte! The overall quality of the sushi here is outstanding and I've brought pretty much all my friends and family back here to try it. Definitely going with the Nozawa trust me is the way to go since the chutoro and otoro as specials are must haves! The price for what you get is unparalleled and the service is great too. Will forever be my favorite sushi spot!
Unce unce unce unce this fish fresh as heck. I'd sell my soul to eat this everyday. I don't even care.

Come for the food (excellent sushi!) try to neglect the service (rude and act like they are doing you a favor....you know the type). It's fast and simple. Very limited menu options but everything tastes great. Nigiri is really good and the handrolls are served with crispy nori and warm sushi rice.

Arrived a little bit past 5 so luckily there wasn't a wait for two. 

I remember coming here years ago and had a great experience, so I'm happy to say that it is still as good as I remembered. Had the Trust Me, and there wasn't a piece that didn't make me close my eyes while enjoying it. 

My favorite part has to be their sushi rice! Wow. Perfect temperature, on the warmer side. But it was seasoned so well.. I'm actually salivating as I type this. It really complemented the fish.

We got the Trust Me platter which was amazing! They don't provide modifications to the sushi rolls (more rice, more sauce, etc). However that is for the best because everything was amazing! With our order we got to try a variety of fish. Everything was fresh and tasted amazing. Salmon melted in my mouth. Tuna was a bit fishy, so maybe not for everyone but I enjoyed it. I usually don't like crab but their hand rolled crab was amazing! I enjoyed every bite.
I had dinner here with a couple of friends other than it being delicious!! The service was amazing and Sage was the best waitress ever!!! I want to thank her for such an amazing experience!
Even the takeout is beautifully presented! Fresh and delicious and very worth the price.

Sugarfish is hands down the BEST sushi I've had so far! The fish is super fresh, flavorful, and not fishy at alll (fishy sushi is the worst). I got the trust me nozawa and loved every single piece. My favorite pieces were the tuna ones and lobster. The tuna sashimi was amazing! I usually liked eel the most but actually thought the eel was just ok compared to all the other pieces. Also, despite the high prices shown on the menu, the restaurant is no tipping! I love having service fees factored into the menu prices.

A year ago, I didn't even eat raw fish and sugarfish made me LOVE it - a must try!
Very fresh, very tasty, easy to order the set up menu. Went back again and aga, try to make it early

I like Sugarfish in LA more, but living near NYC this is some of the best affordable omakase. Something that caught me off guard was that it's a non tipping restaurant. You'll pay your bill and be told there's nothing to sign and you'll feel weird about it  

I got the Nozawa Trust Me which is several pieces of nigiri and hand rolls. There's a specials menu and you can definitely add on to your set. If you get overwhelmed by menus and just want good food just order the Trust Me and put your trust in the experts. I wish more restaurants would set up their menu like this. 

I recommend the ikura, uni, and fatty tuna belly add ons. Enjoy!

Loved and would highly recommend! The entrance is unassuming, but the restaurant has a really chill yet elegant atmosphere. My partner and I wanted to try Omakase style sushi on vacation in new york and this was a great place for a first timer. The menu was extremely simple, and since Omakase can be pricy, I really appreciated that they offer different sized tasting menus at different price points. We split the $56 "Nozawa Trust Me". Each piece was beautiful, fresh, and delicious. We only spent about 45 mins on the meal, so for us it was more of an experience/taste than a full dinner.

Order: dont think just eat, hokkido sea scallops and ankimo (monkfish liver)

Based on the omakase, my takeaways were:
Fish were all super meaty
Wasabi burns like a thousand suns (in a good way)
Rice super fluffy (but falls apart pretty easily)
Handrolls were whatever -- the protein gets easily overpowered by the nori and rice
Unagi was disappointing in that the sweet bbq sauce on top was incredibly light
Ultimately, for omakase, i would stick to the nozawa trust me -- since its essentially the same thing but for $24 less

For the one off orders, my takeaways were
Sea scallops were iffy in that the sauce was overpowering
Monkfish were easily the most memorable fish of the night, super unique and creamy -- a good first experience

For everything else,
Service was pretty iffy -- waiters took 5 mins before i was able to flag someone down for a menu and when the dishes arrived, they spoke so quietly that you cant actually hear them tell you what is what

Bar atmosphere was pretty underwhelming in that they essentially throw all the dirty food/plates in front of you

Worth the hype! We went early around 6pm so there wasn't much of a line yet and we got seated fairly quickly. By the end though they were definitely trying to usher us out. The service was good overall but could've been more attentive. The ambiance was dark and interior was well designed. The bathroom was a pocket door! 

We got a preselected sushi menu with a hand roll. The hand roll was so perfect. It was hot rice wrapped in a crispy seaweed served immediately. The sushi comes out right as it's made so the timing is staggered when you and your party receives the food, but that just means it's ultra fresh! They don't even let you do take out for the hand rolls because it wouldn't be experienced in the right way.

The sake was also delicious!
Amazing food! Highly recommend. Servers are wonderful. Great place to have a date usually quite. The Trust me preset meals are great and a la carte options are great as well.

shoutout to our server esther who rlly refilled out ginger every time it ran out! super observant and thankful. We got the Dont Think Just eat option and the amount of sushi served for the price is a steal. Amazing quality fish and one of the best unagi pieces ive had in ny/nj. Also one of the best tasting uni ive had! I was extremely full by the end of all of the courses even though I thought id still be hungry. Also that lobster hand roll really surprised me in the best way possible. Would go again in a heart beat.

Honestly, this is a great spot to come with others or even solo. Since they don't take reservations and they're usually packed, it's easier to get a seat alone. I like going to sit by the bar area. The experience is like a quick meal that feels like a treat. Sushi pieces are chunky and fresh.

Fabulous. Just go. It's a great place and the food is fantastic. Fun and fabulous! If you love sushi and want fresh fish and fantastic service...well, just go. Great business model, great service and FUN.

This place is consistently great. I used to come here for lunch when I worked in flatiron, and came here tonight for dinner. The "Trust Me" is delicious and just the right about of filling. The cuts are fresh and well seasoned. Service is fast and it's a great spot all in all. If you want the type of place where you can have a long, luxurious dinner, I would not go here because they are pretty efficient and good at getting people in and out (without you feeling too rushed). But I highly recommend this spot regardless.

My favorite sushi restaurant of all time! No other place serves warm sushi rice. I like to get the Trust Me - it's a good size for one person. The price includes tax and tip. 

I also like to order the Unagi (eel) on the side. They char the unagi and don't over dress the sweet sauce. 

In terms of wait time, there's not a way to make reservations. They used to have a waitlist program with Yelp but I am not sure if they still have it. Maybe it's location based? Some stores offer it and some don't. I don't think this location offered it but the Soho one did.

I came here after hearing good things about the LA locations. For a table of 4, I waited about 20 minutes on a Saturday night around 7PM which wasn't too bad. The restaurant itself is very intimate and has dim lights with candlelit tables. Service was very nice and accommodating. 

I got the Dont think, just eat, trust me and it was a pretty good deal for omakase! The quality of fish was great and the flavors complemented each other nicely. My favorite was the otoro and the salmon with sesame on top. 

I left feeling content and think you definitely get your money's worth here. Would come back for sure!
Amazing quality food & great ambiance. Definitely recommend. Special thank you to Cathy for a great experience!

Great sushi and rice. I am very picky about my sushi, especially the rice. The rice is fresh and so is the sushi. I go here alone and often can easily find a spot during rush hours. Their process is efficient and I am in and out before the lunch hour is done. I generally get their Trust Me.

The restaurant is clean and does not allow for tips. If you pay with a card, you don't need to sign anything when you are returned a receipt, freeing up time for the next customer. It's actually not that expensive compared to other sushi places of similar quality, in my opinion, which makes it all the better!

We came into Sugarfish on an early Saturday evening, about 5pm. There was no wait for us - a party of five. The space is simple, but elegant. Dark and intimate with modern, clean wood decor. We were immediately greeted by service staff with water for the table. Our server arrived and asked if we had been to the restaurant before. After saying no, she explained the menu. She appeared to be bothered, like she needed a good break or something. She was short-tempered and not friendly whatsoever. Throughout the service all other staff members were lovely, but her energy was just off (hence the minus one star). She made me uncomfortable. 

The food is stellar. We went with the Nozawa Trust Me Omakase, which was plenty of food. The sushi is just beautiful. Sushi rice is gently warm and super flavorful, with the best texture. The plates were perfectly timed. I'm going to crave this sushi for a long time. I can't wait to come back!

Went here on February 10, right after seeing a show.  Walked in, took a Seat, ate three edamame and noticed worms in my edamame. 
Literally ruined both mine, and my boyfriends appetites. 

We didn't take a picture we were too horrified. We silently got up, took the plate to the woman at the check in, and said "no thank you to dining here today", And walked out 




Check your food before consumption

Heard about this place for so long and so grateful I got to give it a try. Known for being an affordable yet quality omakase spot it def lives up to the hype. 

Walk ins only but they'll put you on a waitlist and update you via text so you can go elsewhere to wait.

Everything here was delicious - so fresh, mindfully prepared. The otoro was my favorite as well as the albacore tuna. The hand rolls were also DELICIOUS and the warm rice - I'm a fan. 

Would def come back here!!

Excellent sushi at this price point. Walk in only, so if you arrive at peak times be prepared to wait around an hour. The 'Trust Me' tasting menus are excellent, highly recommend going with one of those and then adding more pieces if needed. The rice is not packed too tightly so it does fall apart beautifully in your mouth.

Love the no tipping policy, everything is very fair and transparent and the service is very good also.

I came on a weekend evening at 5-6pm. It took like 1 hour to be seated. The interior of the restaurant is very dark and very few light which isn't my favorite. I ordered The Nozawa Trust Me Set. At this location I felt the food was not as good as the soho location. The fish quality is still good and better than your average sushi restaurants in nyc. The customer service here seems the same as soho location maybe a little worst. I guess it has to do with how busy they were. Which also affected the chefs and the quality of the food. Still recommend but come in a not so busy time like the weekday.

Want great sushi after watching a Broadway show, Sugar fish is the spot. They don't take reservations, so best for smaller parties. I really enjoyed their "trust me" tasting menu option. Every dish was fresh and delicious. Also no tipping allowed and excellent service!

Great value for the price. I paid $72 for a full course of sushi.
We were all full. There were 7 courses with about 2 pieces of each type.
However, the sushis aren't as good as regular omakase restaurant.
Nothing to write home about but the good value. The $72 course did come with toro and otoro.

Another plus was that it was a no tipping establishment, which was a big deal for the price.


The wait was also quite long. And the restaurant was rather dark. Maybe they saved all the cost by reducing electricity cost.
WOW!!! when I came here with my husband I was so shocked by how good it was. sugarfish had the best sushi i've had in a long time and i'm definitley coming back

Been wanting to try Sugarfish for a while after loving Kazunori for all these years; a bit let down with the food/more like a 3.5/3.75, but gave 4 stars for benefit of doubt. We arrived at ~720p on a Thursday and there were 32 parties ahead of us; was surprised because Google said not to expect any wait time, so just be warned. We decided to wait it out upstairs since we spent the whole day exploring and were called/sat ~905p. As many have mentioned the restaurant is super dark, but its a nice vibe and cozy with the candles. 

We both ordered the "Don't think. Just eat. Trust Me" and the service begun very fast with the edamame, which definitely tasted like edamame ha. The tuna sashimi course was first and was honestly just ok. For the extra $16 compared to "Nozawa Trust Me" seems like you get yellowtail upgraded to an additional toro, sea bass upgraded to pink lobster, the crab hand roll upgraded to lobster handroll, and an addition of eel nigiri. A decent upgrade, but wish they included some kind of uni or scallop. 

The fish quality is above average, but honestly either the fish is cut thin or there is too much rice, I could not distinguish the taste of the fish that well. No bite from the night was really that memorable. The handrolls were great as always just like Kazunori with great contrast from the warm rice, crunchy seaweed, and cold fish. My gf didn't like the additional eel course that much, but I thought it was fine. 

I'm glad I got to try it and I think for the price its still a pretty good "bargain", but I don't think I would come back and will probably stick to a 6 set from Kazunori.

The staff was very nice and helpful. They knew the menu well. The quality of the fish was good. The decor and vibe of the restaurant was really nice. But the seating was not very spacious and accessible. It was a good experience, but I not a place I'd intentionally go back to.

no words no words no words 

best modern sushi dver

not traditional but still amazing

Nice location for a Sugarfish on 20th and Park Avenue in the Union Square area. We are meeting the kids here for lunch and ordering 4 Trust Me's with a few substitutions like no shrimp aka ebi. It's a smaller location that is very convenient! My daughter had the Nozawa and me and my son and BF had the Trust me.  I was so full and couldn't eat another bite.  
Very satisfying lunch!!
Stopped in for lunch a while back and am still thinking about it. The sushi was fresh, inventive and delicious. Am looking forward to going there next week.

SUGARFISH has the best sushi deals in all of NYC! My roommates and I eat here weekly because of how much we love the food. The fish is always fresh and we've brought countless friends here so they can try it themselves. You likely will have to wait for a table, but the staff do a great job at being accommodating.

Small intimate and upscale vibe. Everything I ordered had amazing flavor. The Unagi was my favorite however the sweet shrimp as well as the Hokkaido Scallops weren't too far behind. Looking forward to dining here again on my next visit to NYC.
Best sushi in NYC. Always fresh and on point. Highly recommend- 5 stars!!!!!!!!!!!!!!

The detail in the takeout sushi box packaging will not be left unnoticed, and Sugarfish does it right!

I got the To-Go Trust Me ($43) for pickup, which I was kind of surprised to see they didn't take tips. The box itself was ginormous. I almost thought I forgot to grab chopsticks and napkins until I realized they are tucked neatly at the bottom of the box! Another fan girl moment for me was the names of the sushi printed on the box and the instructions on how to eat each one. I have always wanted to know what fish I was eating, so this was much appreciated!

Personally, the packaging excited me more than the sushi itself. The rice was a lot softer than I had imagined, with rice falling apart every time I dunk them in soy sauce. The lemon wedge wasn't the most practical to squeeze juice out of it. From the fish selections, the Yellowtail seems to always be my fave in every sushi place I've had them in. Out of the regular rolls, the Crab one stood out for being creamy. 

I totally underestimated how much was actually in this box, as I was incredibly stuffed by the end of it! 

While not the best sushi, possibly because of the rice, the packaging has my heart! The soy sauce can get quite messy, but this is your picnic item to splurge on for those nice summer days!
Got a trust me box to go and it was perfect as usual. The fish was the perfect temp even though it was for pick up.

i ordered the nozawa trust me and it was perfection ! i dream of this sushi
wish i didnt live so far away :/
Hostesses told us that it would be an hour wait then texted us our table was ready. An hour and a half later we are still waiting and the hostesses refuse to make eye contact with us. Real classy

Great Sugarfish location with the same consistent quality as the others. Like the other restaurants, this also has a dimly lit interior that makes it a great date spot. We came here around 7 pm on the weekend, so it was full but we didn't have to wait long for a spot. They have a spacious waiting area on the second floor (this is also where the bathrooms are). The waitstaff was also very nice.

Nozawa Trust Me ($56) - This was the second tier on the dinner menu. While it's pricy, the fish was high quality. Everything was super tender and melted in your mouth. The waitstaff did a great job of timing the dishes too, since they brought it out plate by plate. I was definitely full by the end of this. 

Nozawa Sake ($15) - This was 6 ounces, so one bottle per person is about appropriate. It was strong enough to get the lightest touch of tipsy but not much more. Tasted alright too, not too hard to go down.

Nice location in Flatiron. The Trust Me is a perfect lunch portion. 

All the food is tasty. $37 is a very reasonable price especially with it inclusive of service. 

My only notch on the place is that I think the pieces of sushi and handrolls are hastily assembled and fall apart easily.

Waited about an hour to get seated. 

Service was on par, staff explained the menu and the dishes. Didn't wait too long for each dish 

I just want to say this place is good for its price for sushi tasting but the rice is way too sweet with vinegar and not fluffy. It could've been borderlines mushy. The rice would all fall apart because of the liquid consistency. The raw fish isn't the greatest quality and you can taste the difference

Ambiance is dark with a candle on the table. Clean and no note worthy interior design  

4/10 for the food but 4/5 stars for its price point

My son and husband love this place. Excellant warm sushi rice lightly rolled topped with cold fish. Best sashimi outside of Japan they say. The service is impeccable and fast. The prices are amazing . The decor simple, elegant with clean lines . Modern Japanese style. Low lighting in the evening, high noise level on a Saturday night . The place for fine Japanese with sublime sushi.
Here's the deal:   One of the 3 great tasting menu is the way to experience Sugerfish   Service is great!  Love the sushi !!

I was going to order the trust me set, only to find the belly cuts were now being replaced with cheaper cuts and the price was not being adjusted. I asked for consideration and was denied by the manager. The sushi looked cheap, small, and uninteresting. So, I headed to blue ribbon instead. Way better option. Skip this place.

They forgot a course on my companion's coursed meal - gave us the check, and then brought out a wrong dish after without us asking them. They then took it away, and then brought something else back and when we said we didn't want it because we were on a time crunch they asked if we wanted it to go. It's not like I expect anything for free if a restaurant messes up but at the same time, a manager coming out and explaining what happened and apologizing would have been nice.

Food wise, it's overpriced for what they serve. Fish is not that fresh, I'd rather just grab some bodega sushi next time if I want a quick meal.

The staff is super friendly and the quality of sushi is pretty decent.  We went during lunch time and there was a bit of a crowd on a Friday afternoon in August.

The reason for the 4 and not 5 is the ponzu sauce all over 1/2 the sashimi pieces:(. That was a waste of good fish unfortunately!!!

Sugarfish is a high quality franchise that offers excellent food at a somewhat reasonable price. The service is friendly and they do a good job of getting your food out fairly quickly.  The restaurant is a bit dark but it's relaxed and comfortable. I had to wait over an hour for a single seat at the bar so spent the time at a nearby pub. I had the Trust Me dinner which had a good mix of tastes and textures. The food came out fresh and at the perfect temperature. Delicious! I'd definitely put this on my return visit list. Enjoy.

The food is not really fresh and the biggest issue is management attitude and cleanliness 
As a sushi space you're probably just going to ignore the garbage outside and ignorance to hygiene ? 
Definitely not going back her
LOVED it!!! Great great food. NO tipping policy....that was a bonuse I hadnt expected. We had a great experience.

Love love love sugarfish!!! I always do the Nozawa trust me and leave full, happy, and with my wallet feeling happy! The fish quality is amazing for the price (especially since there is no tip) and just a great consistent sushi spot

I'm telling you, this place is the best, freshest sushi I've had. The trust me menus give all the trust in the world. So good! They are right by my office in NYC and every time I travel in, they are a must have. The people that work there have been nothing but pleasant and seem like they love their jobs. Always a good experience. Thank you for giving me the sushi experience I love!
Quick delivery, no frills, no problems, very nice takeout boxes.  Doesn't compare to a few better places but had a great advantage of being available and responsive

I enjoyed my lunch here very much. A no-frills restaurant with a dim lit ambiance. Every signal fish of fish was fresh and delicious. No specialty pieces but all of the cuts they provided were very good. 
Service was great. It gets busy in there even for lunch but the line was well worth it

I came in with my sister to pop her Sugarfish cherry. I've been to the SoHo location and I must say I prefer the SoHo location. We came in and they told us there was a wait, which was ok. The wait time was pretty accurate in my opinion. We sat down, the waiter didn't come by for about 5 minutes. He was pretty forgetful, I ordered a sake and a beer. He forgot the beer. When I told him about it, he brought me the wrong one but that's ok. We ordered the Nowaza Omakase, they did forget some of the courses. We had to tell them that we were missing things and it was the same with the table next to us. It was interesting to say the least. I'm just glad my sister enjoyed it but I'll be going to soho instead.

We were craving sushi and a few friends suggested this place. We arrived a little after 12 and we're able to be seated right away- but by the tie we finished lunch the place was totally packed and they were taking names. Servers were friendly and efficient. We went with the Omikase. Everything tasted fresh and the presentation was great too.

Such an impressive meal! I ordered the "trust me" tasting menu, and really enjoyed every course. The building is gorgeous and the service was great as well. They do not take reservations so I'd recommend putting your name on the list and walking around flatiron until your table is ready.

Continues to be one of my favorite sushi restaurants in the City for many years. Recommend ordering one of their pre-set options for a better deal.

All their ingredients are delicious and fresh, and they master their rice AND service here.

Overall 5 stars! Always a go-to when I am in NYC.
Best experience and the most delicious food that I've ever had in sushi restaurant 5-stars! Would recommend to anyone!

FIrst time at sugarfish as i know it's a pretty popular spot as they have locations in nyc & la. I decided to go with the prefix menu of Nozawa Trust Me. Which came with:

Edamame
Tuna Sashimi - ponzu and chives
Albacore Sushi - ponzu and chives, 2-pc
Salmon Sushi - toasted sesame, 2-pc
Toro Hand Roll
Japanese Yellowtail* Sushi - lemon, 2-pc
Chutoro Sushi, 2-pc
Sea Bass Sushi - yuzu ponzu, 1-pc
New Zealand Sea Bream* Sushi - citrus salt, 1-pc
Blue & Dungeness Crab Hand Roll

My favorites were definiltely the albacore sushi, toro handroll and Chutoro sushi which was melt in the mouth. I don't have as much experience with sushi and especially sushi in nyc so hard to speak on the value. But i think it's a great ambiance and perfect spot for a date. My only gripe was that i got seated at probably the worst seat in the house near the end of the bar where the kitchen is where all the waiters walk by and collect orders and throw out uneaten food. It kind of killed the environment for me. 

On the positive note, sugarfish is a non-tippping establishment. Which I really like as the labor costs are built into the prefixed menu charge (RESTAURANTS PAY YOUR WORKERS A LIVING WAGE).

The website (https://sugarfishsushi.com/locations/flatiron/) clearly states, "we do not take reservations." We arrived around 6PM on 11/30/2023 and were promptly asked by the hostess if we had a reservation. There was a wait of 45 tables. If the website stated that reservations were accepted, we would have made one.

Used to love their Trust Me (went there all the time last year) but when I went recently, it seems like the quality slightly went down. The fish wasn't as fresh and the service was more chaotic than normal.
It's still a solid spot though.
Such fresh sushi and really nice place to get fresh rolls. Would recommend to anyone looking for good food

Love eating here! I come here often whenever I need to take someone to a place with good food and no reservations. They can get pretty busy, so would recommend arriving around noon on weekends to get a table. The Trust Me is a good portion - love that the sushi is pre-sauced so that there's great flavor.
The fish was fresh. There was a pretty long wait for the lunch rush and they don't let you leave your phone number. The service was just okay. The rice falls apart easily.

Delish!! I took my girlfriend here for her birthday. I am not giving them 5 stars because of the reservation/sitting process. 
The food was melting in our mouths. Delicious! Ambiance is super cool. Great for a date night.

Amazing every time I go for dinner or lunch, you can't go wrong. The fish is so fresh I can eat it 6 days a week if it was closer to me. 
I hope one opens closer to me than an hour and a half away.

Do yourself a favor and please come try this magnificent establishment. We had the "don't think. Just eat. Trust me." And it was a heavenly experience of sashimi and hand rolls. Washed down with a Sapporo Reserve. I come to this place at least twice a month

So I loooove Sugarfish and frequent often because I'm addicted! The last few times at the flatiron location, the service has been disappointing. First I was asked if I'd like anything else with my meal before the check, and I was only halfway through the meal. Bit that's ok. Then I left the restaurant and returned forgetting my purse. The girl at the counter said, I'll be there in a moment and just stood there I told 2 others and they just stared at me. Then I told them I was anxious about my purse and would appreciate them looking or that I could look myself   (at the empty table). They just stared at me. Really weird. Finally one of the girls went to retrieve my purse. It was like a power stand off.... Not the way I would have handled it.

Food was excellent as usual though!

NOT GLUTEN FREE FRIENDLY. Never had any issues at Sugarfish in SoHo but this one really let me down. I bought a gluten free friend because the SoHo location was always great about it. Here they had no tamari, and made her feel really bad about asking for a little lemon, salt or vinegar. The manager came out and basically berated us about how it would be too costly for them to accommodate that and that the kitchen is really locked down on what they can use. It's okay to just say no and not make someone feel bad. She just wanted to add a little moisture and flavor to her food. The food was fine. They also kept saying "gluten safe" which is hilarious because it was gluten FREE but not a safe space for those with celiac or GF.

sugarfish never disappoints. the minute we walked in we were greeted by two of the nicest and most kind and helpful people; eva (main host) and wendy (manager). their job is quite stressful with customers that lack patience BUT eva and wendy handled themselves (and their customers) with such patience and grace. i also want management to know that sean (runner) was/is also exceptional. such a good guy and sooo hardworking. sugarfish, you are so fortunate to have eva, wendy and sean on your side. thank them for us. we appreciated the whole experience.

I've seen people in LA constantly posting these amazing takeout boxes from Sugarfish, and so when we moved to NYC, I made it my mission to try one. I'm so glad I did, because it was delicious! It's easily the best takeout sushi I've ever had, and the high quality definitely justifies the higher cost. It was a lot of fun trying out the difference pieces and dressing the fish ourselves. We did one deluxe sampler I believe plus a few additional pieces of sushi and a roll, and it was more than enough for two people!

Walked in during lunch time and was able to snag a spot at the sushi bar. Service was quick and very friendly! I got the lunch trust me and everything came out so quickly. I am a huge fan of Sugarfish, but typically order to go so I don't usually get to experience the sit down service. Everything was fresh as always and so tasty. Will be back in person again!
Love the sushi and their concept of choices.  Quality of sushi is great and pricing is reasonable.

We had 6 people so naturally the wait was longer than expect,- but ALWAYS worth the wait. The manager, Scott, was genuinely apologetic. That is one of my favorite things about this place. Every single employee, without fail, is genuine. The food speaks for itself.  Favorite place and location, hands down!

Food was very good. The service not as much. I think because the tip is included, the services aren't focused on giving outstanding service. They are going through the motions. 
I tried to order more food and it was impossible.  I guess for some people this is great; not for me.

I've only ever ordered online, but they are always perfect, so I can't imagine how they are in person. The Trustme offers a perfect blend of everything and leaves you satisfied. Overall, it's really tasty.

Incredibly rude staff here but in general sugarfish has become the cheesecake factory of sushi. People go there thinking its a nice place but its really a cheap gimmicky place masquerading as a high end sushi spot by a master chef. 
This chef has so many rules, you wonder why youre even paying premium to not eat the way you want to eat your meal. 
Ive had food poisoning from TWO locations (beverly hills and flatiron NY). First time, thought it was a fluke but second time just reflect their decline in quality while still price gouging. 
So many better spots. Save your money

Food is 5/5 stars. Definitely sit at the bar for the good AC and quick plates from the kitchen and our waitress Sarah. 

Staff is 3/5 stars. All 3 stars are for our waitress, a dark haired waiter and one hostess. Our waitress, Sarah, was quick and attentive and very friendly. The one brunette hostess was very kind as well. The rest of the waitstaff acted like high schoolers running around at their first job. Three pieces of glassware broke during our meal at the bar. The blonde waitress was constantly yapping with the kitchen staff. Which is fine... just not while you're on your shift and the dishes aren't getting out quickly. And she touched my chopsticks like 4 times which is uncomfortable in this day and age with rampant germs. Anyways, great meal. Great service from our waitress. Soap Opera train wreck was how the rest of the staff was acting.

Our go-to place for good quality sushi. We always opt for the Nozawa Trust Me, and the best bites out of the meal by far are the Tuna Sashimi and the Blue & Dungeness Crab Hand Roll. For the price, it is definitely worth it and even the regular Trust Me course will leave you feeling full. 

Everything is fresh and seasoned to perfection. Unlike DOMODOMO, there were no overwhelming bites of wasabi. 

It's really a guessing game for how quickly you can get seated; whenever we go its either extremely busy with a 45 minute+ wait or we get seated right away. 

The reason why I only give 4 stars is because the staff always makes us feel rushed. Even before we finish a dish or if only one person is done, the next course is brought out to us right away. Once, our waiter kept asking if they could take our unfinished edamame plate all throughout the meal, even though we wanted to take little bites of it in between courses. We understand that servers would want to quickly turnover tables to alleviate high wait times, but it's a little too excessive in my opinion.

Overall: Always a hit! I've gone multiple times. It's always fresh and I've had a great experience at multiple locations. They also have a great carry out option in a cute little box! 

Reservation: Walk in!

Service: Nothing noteworthy

Ambiance: It's a nice restaurant. Very reasonably priced, but the vibes feel nicer than the cost in a positive way.

Food: Always get the Nozawa Trust me. The crab handroll is always my favorite and the marinated tuna is amazing. It doesn't seem like a ton of food at first but I always leave full.

First time at Sugarfish and thought it was worth a try. Ordered The Nozawa Trust Me and for the price, it was good. Really enjoyed the toro and blue & dungeness crab rolls. The restaurant is dark and moody so would be a great date spot. Service was also quick and thorough.

Hands down my favorite sushi in the city!

I always get the Trust Me, and it's great whether dining in or to-go. It's such a great deal (especially when dining in because you can't tip) -- worth every penny. 

While you can't make a reservation, the wait is worth it. I like that they space it out when you get any of the Trust Me sets; they bring it in different courses, so it makes it more of an experience. I also appreciate that they're accommodating & let you sub things (I always sub the crab roll to a salmon roll)! 

It's also really fun to get to go; it looks so pretty & organized in the box, and it makes it really fun to put the corresponding toppings & sauces with the different fish. It makes you appreciate it more (whereas with other takeout sushi I just inhale it in 10 minutes haha).

Even people who are picky about sushi & typically would prefer spicy tuna rolls are obsessed when I bring them here! It's simple yet EXTREMELY delicious. But beware, if you're looking for things like spicy tuna rolls & crazy mayos and sauces and such - this is not the place for you!
Was excited to try this place because I love Kazunori. Unfortunately the food is underwhelming food and the service very poor. Will not return!

Fish was excellent. But the server pushed us out before we even got our last dishes, asking us if we wanted the check. And then grabbed all our utensils and sides before it came. 

Sloppy end to an otherwise wonderful night.
Our party all had the "Don't Ask, Just Eat" omakase. Loved each of the pieces. Standouts for us included the toro sushi, toro roll, and lobster roll.
Love this place! Consistently delicious and love their simple business model. Makes it easy and fun and the fish is always super fresh, the staff members always on point.
Amazing!!! The sushi was so buttery & melted in your mouth, literally the best sushi I've ever had. Can't wait to come back.

Sugarfish has been my go to sushi place whenever I want decent quality sushi without breaking the bank. I feel like my experiences with sugarfish have been consistently good, and the atmosphere is nice as well. They don't do reservations, which often works in favor of me

Super nice staff. Food courses were brought out at a nice pace. We had the $50 Nozawa lunch option that came with several courses. It was a good value. It was tasty and nice option. Every course had tasty and fresh fish. The only issue was the rice fell apart with several pieces, I like it more sticky. 

The service and value here are very good. Especially considering this is a no tip restaurant. It's great to see happy servers who are paid appropriately by their employer and don't depend on randoms to tip. The service was excellent!

I don't live nearby anymore, so I don't think I'll visit again. But it was a great 1 time experience!

As a fan of Kazunori, I knew that Sugarfish wouldn't disappoint! I came with a friend and fellow kazunori fan for an early dinner, and we were thankfully seated really quickly around 5:30pm. About 30 mins later, the restaurant was packed!

We both decided on the Trust Me ($46), and it came with a decent amount of food! I looove the ponzu sauce that they put, which provides the perfect amount of acidity without overpowering the fish. Favorite pieces include the yellowtail and albacore, and the toro and crab handrolls. I was just about full, but needed a little something more to feel satisfied, so I got an additional bay scallop hand roll ($7). My friend ordered another crab handroll - this was seriously so good. Our final total came out to about $63pp (no tipping here).

Probably a bit on the pricier end for the amount of food, but everything was really fresh. I personally prefer kazunori a bit more for its value & handrolls, but I enjoyed Sugarfish!

Ambiance is casual - perfect for a quick dinner!

After leaving a previous review on yelp, their team kindly reached out to me and asked me to give them another try assuring better service - so my friends and I did. 

The sushi, as always, was very tasty. The albacore, and the crab handrolls were my favorite. Quality was excellent - no doubt some of the best raw fish in the city. 

The service was better this time - waters were filled, ginger was replaced, we were even given free sushi, otoro and albacore, which was very very kind of them. However, it still felt very frantic. Waiters were literally running from the kitchen stand to the tables with plates in their hands, my friend asked for lemons and they forgot (reminded them and they brought some), plates were still slammed depending on the rush, and our soy sauce jar hadn't been cleaned. Having said this, the manager and our main waiter were very kind and tried to make us happy which I really appreciated despite their chaotic night. 

Sugarfish is great but for me, Kazu Nori will still be the go-to; it's a calmer environment with a more organized concept. 4.5 stars would be accurate.

we had  "Trust Me"  set lunch for $39.00 each which included:  Edamame, Tuna Sashimi - ponzu and chives, Albacore Sushi - ponzu and chives, 2-pc
Salmon Sushi - toasted sesame, 2-pc
Toro Hand Roll, Japanese Yellowtail* Sushi - lemon, 1-pc Sea Bass Sushi - yuzu ponzu, 1-pc Blue & Dungeness Crab Hand Rollh. All served separately as available. They are very particular about rules (no soy on already sauced items!; eat the hand rolls RIGHT AWAY!) the star was efficient and friendly. My only issue is the rice isn't sticky enough to stay together when dipped in soy, which seems a basic sushi rule THEY shouldn't observe. Overall a decent lunch at not too bad of a price.

Sugarfish has been on my list for a while so I came while I was in town in NYC. Came here for dinner on a Sunday night at around 6pm. The place was packed, and we waited for about an hour to get a table for 2.

However, the ambiance is cute and dark--a very nice dinner spot. We did one of the "dinner trust me's," and everything tasted super fresh.

The Blue & Dungeness crab hand roll was definitely my favorite out of everything. However, everything was still super yummy.

Although it was good, I wouldn't come and wait an hour for a table again. I prefer having a reservation somewhere, but I think I'd definitely get takeout or come back for lunch.

Decent sushi for NYC.  The waitlist is generally long (I think at 6:30pm I was the 16th on a waitlist for a table of 2 on a Saturday; we ended up being seated around 7:30pm-8pm).  But time passed as I was catching up with a friend.  The ambiance of the restaurant is dark and the 'Trust Me' Omakase experience can feel a bit rushed, but even after we paid the bill my friend and I ended up talking most of the night and we were never rushed off our table, which I appreciated.  Overall, probably a solid spot for a date or to catch up with friends, with decent sushi quality for a reasonable price in NYC. I can see why it's popular.
Pretty average all around, not bad for a snack but probably won't be back. Not a lot of flavor for these fish that are local

ARI IS THE BEST. 

I can't say enough about the amazing experience I had at Sugarfish NYC! Not only was the food incredible (seriously, every bite was perfection), but our server, Ari, made the night unforgettable. From the moment we sat down, she was so warm, kind, and conversational. It felt like she was genuinely excited to guide us through the menu and ensure we had the best time possible.  

Ari's energy and passion for what she does really shine through, and her attention to detail is unmatched. She made the whole experience feel special. Honestly, she's the kind of server that makes you want to come back, just to have her take care of you again. She is fantastic--can't recommend her enough!  

If you're going to Sugarfish, ask for Ari--you won't regret it!

Really good sushi for the price. I was impressed by the amount of food in the sets. I ordered the "Nozawa Trust Me" ($50) and it came with 2 appetizers, 10 pcs of sushi and 2 handrolls. The fish was thick and fresh, really good quality for the price. The only problem with my meal was that the rice on the nigiri was too warm and was falling apart. 

Overall, good sushi, would come back.

Let me start off and say the food quality and taste were really great. The only reason for 3 stars was that the rice was warm and fell apart for every single piece we received. Not sure if they were rushing the process but good sushi rice should be formed and can picked up with your fingers and chopsticks. Hopefully, this isn't their usual way of serving rice!
Consistently quality sushi at a competitive price in a comfortable setting. Their omakase options are always fun.

Horrible service 
Felt rushed
The young waiters were very rude 
Fish was okay. Not as fresh as I thought it would be .

We got the 'Trust me' set menu. I'm never a fan of edamame, so that was 2/10 for me. The tuna sashimi was a 10/10, hits all the right flavours. The yellow tail, nigiri, hand rolls and everything else after were alright. It's very fresh though. The dishes kept coming so def. worth your $$
The waiters were all super nice, very vibey. Honestly, so concentrated in the food and convos didn't pay too much attention to ambience.

My first dining experience at Sugarfish was pretty amazing. My friend and I arrived around 12:30 for lunch and we were seated almost immediately. The only hiccup was not getting menus when we were seated, so we had to wait a bit to finally get menus to look at. 

We both ordered the Nowaza Trust Me and enjoyed every course! All of their fish was so fresh and every bite was so satisfying. My top favorite sushis from this set were the chutoro sushi, yellowtail, and albacore. The last blue & dungeness crab hand roll was the perfect way to end the course and was so delicious as well. Every course came out very timely and the waitstaff were great! 

I would definitely come back for another meal!

Not coming back to this location again. Has left a very sour taste in my mouth after multiple interactions with unprofessional staff, almost ruined my birthday dinner. In the past they have changed our order without notifying us and would not compensate even though we paid for a specific item, effectively scamming my party out of the equivalent of $50.

Landon was the best!! He made the whole dinner worth it. also love the scallop roll
will come back again

Sugarfish in the Flatiron District offers a delightful sushi experience with fresh, high-quality ingredients attentive service, and a chill relaxed ambiance. Although some options were sold out during my visit, the flexibility to create your own omakase from the à la carte menu was a great alternative. The nigiri featured well-portioned, beautifully seasoned slabs of fish, paired with rice that was flavorful though slightly delicate and prone to falling apart. Despite this minor detail, the overall quality of the meal was exceptional.
The biggest drawback was the hour-long wait, but the friendly and attentive service made up for it. The staff ensured everything ran smoothly, and keep in mind all of nigiri you order does not come out at once and it might take a few minutes for the other items to get to you so you might as well eat as everything is served to you. Also please note  tipping isn't included but the excellent service deserved recognition. I'm considering a return visit to explore their seasonal premium sushi, especially if they have uni or other rare offerings available. Sugarfish is a spot worth visiting for sushi enthusiasts who appreciate both quality and care.

Walked in on a Friday at 1pm and got seated right away at the bar. Ambiance was darkly lit and moody feeling. The sushi was just alright, my favorite was probably the tuna sashimi but everything else was just pretty average. Nothing mind blowing. The service was very kind, but also really really slow. Just wasn't too impressed by this place and I thought it was kind of pricy all in all.
